samas.samasTitleEnglish: Valmik Stavan Nirupan (A Discourse in Praise of Valmiki)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: धव्य धन्य तो वाल्मीक । ऋषीमाजी पुण्यश्र्लोक । जयाचे हा त्रिलोक । पावन जाला ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ऋषींमधील पुण्यश्र्लोक असा तो वाल्मीकि अतिशय धन्य होय. हे तीन्ही लोक त्यानें पावन केलें.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed, most blessed is valmiki. Within that rishi there was this harmonious poem `I am' and due to this poem, the three worlds were purified and that thoughtless swarup was revealed.

owis.original: भविष्य आणी शतकोटी । हें तो नाहीं देखिलें दृष्टीं । धांडोळितां सकळ सृष्टि । श्रुत नव्हे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भविष्यकाळीं घडणारेआणि तें शतकोटी रामायण वाल्मीकिनें आधींच रचिलें. सारी सृष्टी धुंडाळली तरी अशी गोष्ट दुसर्‍याकोणीं केलीली पाहण्यांत किंवा ऐकण्यांत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Either there is a future (and therefore a past and a present) or there is that pure sattwa guna that can be learnt through the hundreds of ways shown in the ramayan (and then, no future or past remains and there is only this `now' or `all'). And when that thoughtless Self is understood then, even this `all' will not be perceived. But first you must search out this `all' and then, this gross creation and the vedas will not remain? (When this `all' is understood then, the gross world with the concepts of past, present and future, the vedas and the teachings of this scripture called the *ramayan will not remain). *(The ramayan is the story of ram written by valmiki. It also means a long and tedious tale)

owis.original: भविष्याचें येक वचन । कदाचित जालें प्रमाण । तरी आश्र्चिर्य मानिती जन । भूमंडळीचे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भविष्यांत घडून येणारी गोष्ट जरी कोणीं आधीं सांगितलीं आणि ती त्याप्रमाणें घडून आली तर जगांतील लोकांना त्याचे मोठे आश्र्चर्य वाटते.
owis.englishMeaning: If the thought of a future (ie. mind's hopes and dreams) becomes this divine `speech' and if after some time, that One nirgun authority is understood then, that man of this world was having respect for this wonder of `I am' (only the one who has respect for this `I am' can escape this mundane existence and reach Reality).

owis.original: नसतां रघुनाथ अवतार । नाहीं पाहिला शास्त्राधार । रामकथेचा विस्तार । विस्तारिला जेणें ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पण रामाचा अवतार झालेला नव्हता, दुसरा कांहीं शास्त्राधार नव्हता असें असतांना देखील ज्यानें रामकथा सविस्तर सांगितलीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is that nirgun authority then, even this *avatar of ram is not. However this has not been understood by those that uphold the shasthras (the scriptures can take you up to `I am'/knowledge. Thus the upholders of the scriptures have not understood that essence that is nirgun and they say that this avatar ie. `I am' or being in the `now', is the Truth). And it is from this `story of ram' (ie. knowledge) that this long tedious tale has appeared and expanded (ram is always in His Self, He has never come down. His `story' or `poem' is His avatar or to come down, and this is `I am'. And afterwards this expansion, expanded further and this gross world appeared and this scripture they call the ramayan along with the vedas and shasthras were written). *(maharaj- avatar means to come down into knowledge)

owis.original: ऐसा जयाचा वाग्विळास । ऐकोनी संतोषला महेश । मग विभागिलें त्रयलोक्यास । शतकोटी रामायेण ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असा हा वाल्मीकिचा वाग्विलास होता. तो ऐकून श्रीशंकर प्रसन्न झालें. मग शतकोटी रामायणाचे तिन्ही लोकांसाठीं विभाग केलें.
owis.englishMeaning: *mahesh became content while listening to this beautiful story of mula maya. But later, this `story' got distributed throughout the three worlds and so that pure sattwa became this long, tedious tale of a mundane existence. *(You are mahesh, the destroyer of this gross creation; just forget everything and He is there)

owis.original: ज्याचें कवित्व शंकरें पाहिलें । इतरां न वचे अनुमानलें । रामउपासकांसी जालें । परम समाधान ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सामान्य माणसाला वाल्मीकीच्या काव्यशक्तीची कल्पना करतां येणें शक्य नाहीं. श्रीशंकराला ती करतां आली. श्रीरामाच्या उपासकांना फार मोठें समाधान वाटलें.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' poem was understood by lord shiva (ie. nothing is true). Others in this world did not understand it and they could only make conjecture and give their opinions (and read and discuss the ramayan etc.). But the one who becomes a *devotee to ram gains the contentment of that Supreme Self. *(Devoted to thoughtlessness)

owis.original: ऋषी होते थोर थोर । बहुतीं केला कवित्वविचार । परी वाल्मीकासारिखा कवेश्र्वर । न भूतो न भविष्यति ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पूर्वींच्या पुष्कळ मोठमोठ्या ऋषींनी कवित्व रचना केली. पण वाल्मीकि हा एकच कवीश्वर असा कीं जो न भूतो न भविष्यति.
owis.englishMeaning: He is a rishi and the `greatest of the great' when, in this poem `I am', thoughtlessness has been created. Then he becomes like valmiki and a Lord of this `poem', with no past and no future and no present.

owis.original: पूर्वीं केली दृष्ट कर्में । परी पावन जाला रामनामें । नाम जपतां दृढ नेमें । पुण्यें सीमा सांडिली ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पूर्वायुष्यांत वाल्मीकिनें फार दुष्ट कर्में केली. परंतु रामनामानें तो पावन झाला. अत्यंत दृढ निश्र्चयानें त्यानें रामनाम जपलें. त्यामुळें त्याच्या पुण्याला कांहीं सीमा उरली नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously many wicked actions had been committed by him (ie. by taking himself to be a body). Nevertheless, by taking the `name' of ram, he became pure. In the same way, if you continuously and earnestly repeat His `name' then, the merit acquired will transgress all limits.

owis.original: उफराटें नाम म्हणतां वाचें । पर्वत फु्टले पापाचे । ध्वज उभारले पुण्याचे । ब्रह्मांडावरुते ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो आपल्या वाणीनें रामाचें नाम उलटें उच्चारीत होता. तरी त्याच्या पापाचे पर्वत फुटुन नाहींसें झालें. जगामध्यें त्याच्या पुण्याचे निशाण फडकले.
owis.englishMeaning: If you say His `name' then, these four speeches will be *reversed and this mountain of sin (ie. body consciousness) will crumble and the flags of merit will be unfurled beyond the brahmanda (ie. beyond the gross creation. Then you will become knowledge). *(ie. the vaikhari becomes madhyama, then pashyanti and then, this para/`I am')

owis.original: वाल्मीकें जेथें तप केलें । तें वन पुण्यपावन जालें । शुष्क काष्ठीं अंकुर फुटले । तपोबळें जपाच्या ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या वनामध्यें वाल्मीकिनें तप केलें तें वन देखील त्याच्या पुण्याईनें पवित्र झालें. त्याच्या तपाच्या बळानें कोरड्या लाकडांना अंकुर फुटलें.
owis.englishMeaning: When valmiki performed this penance `here' then, this *forest became a holy place (ie. the gross world became this world beyond). Due to his powerful penance, there appeared this sprout of `I am' within this dry wood (siddharameshwar maharaj- this body is like dead wood if this antar-atma is not there). *(The gross world is like a forest and the `many' bodies are like the dry trees)2

owis.original: पूर्वी होता वाल्हाकोळी । जीवघातकी भूमंडळीं । तोचि वंदिजे सकळीं । विबुधीं आणि ऋषेश्र्वरीं ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आधी वाल्हा कोळी होता. जगांत त्यानें पुष्कळ जीवांची हिंसा केली होती. पण पुढें पंडित व मोठमोठे ऋषी त्यास वंदन करुं लागले.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously valmiki had been a fisherman and he had been a killer of many jivas in the world (ie. by taking himself to be a body we become a jiva; he passed through many lifetimes, having many occupations and playing many roles and got born and died many times, thus killing many jiva). But then he understood that the One within this `all' should be worshipped and he became the Lord of the rishis, most learned and wise.

owis.original: उपरति आणि अनुताप । तेथें कैंचे उरेल पाप । देह्यांततपें पुण्यरुप । दुसरा जन्म जाला ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याला उपरति झाली व ज्याला पश्र्चाताप झाला त्याच्या ठिकाणीं पाप उरणें शक्य नसतें. देहाचा नाश करण्यापर्यंत तप केल्यानें त्या तपाचरणानें अत्यंत पुण्यरुप असा जणुं काय दुसरा जन्मच त्यास प्राप्त झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: When one is wearied of worldly pursuits and full of repentance and surrender then, how will the sin of body consciousness remain `there'? When this body consciousness is renounced then, there is this merit of `I am' and one is `born again' (ie. one is born again, this time while in the body and this time into knowledge).

owis.original: अनुतापें आसन घातलें । देह्यांचें वारुळ जालें । तेंचि नाम पुढें पडिलें । वाल्मीक ऐसें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पश्र्चाताप होऊन त्यानें आसान मांडलें. त्याच्या देहाभोवती वारुळ वाढलें. त्यामुळें त्याला लोक पुढें वाल्मीकि असें म्हणूं लागलें.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to his repentance and surrender, body consciousness was tossed away and the gross body became an *ant-hill (ie. this `all'). This `all' is the poem and later when this poem ended, valmiki did not remain and there was that Reality, the Lord of this `poem'. *(See 13.9.10; this `all' is like an ant-hill. It is empty and within it many small ants ie. jiva, run hither and thither)

owis.original: वारुळास वाल्मीक बोलिजे । म्हणोनि वाल्मीक नाम साजे । जयाच्या तीव्र तपें झिजे । हृदय तापसाचें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वारुळाला वाल्मीक म्हणतात. म्हणून त्याला वाल्मीकि नाव शोभतें. त्याची तपस्या पाहून तपस्वी लोकांचें हृदय कापतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore valmiki should be called this `all', for valmiki had become this `name'. And when one repeats the *`name'/nam of ram with firm resolve then, the heart of that sage will get worn away. *(maharaj- nam means na, not and aham, I am)

owis.original: जो तापसांमाजीं श्रेष्ठ । जो कवेश्र्वरांमधें वरिष्ठ । जयाचें बोलणें पष्ट । निश्र्चयाचें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वाल्मीकि तपस्वी लोकांत श्रेष्ठ आहे. कविगणांमध्यें तो फार वरच्या दर्जाचा आहे. त्याचे बोलणें फार स्पष्ट व निश्र्चित असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Thoughtlessness is within this sage. In that Lord of the `poem' there is pure knowledge when this `speech' of mula maya is completely cleaned and doubt no longer remains.

owis.original: जो निष्ठावंतांचें मंडण । रघुनाथभक्तांचें भूषण । ज्याची धारणा असाधारण । साधकां सदृढ करी ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्या असाधारण निष्ठेमुळें तो निष्ठावंतांची शोभा आहे. श्रीराम भक्तांचे तो भूषण आहे. त्याची विलक्षण धारणा बघून साधकाची साधन निष्ठा पक्की होते.
owis.englishMeaning: That purush is the place of the most faithful and this place adorns the devotee of ram. That understanding of the purush belongs to the sadhak who has great determi- nation and faith.

owis.original: धन्य वाल्मीक ऋषेश्र्वर । समर्थाचा कवेश्र्वर । तयासी माझा नमस्कार । साष्टांगभावें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समर्थ रामरायाचे यश गाणारा कवीश्र्वर वाल्मीकि धन्य होय. अशा या ऋषीश्र्वराला मी श्रद्धापूर्वक साष्टांग नमस्कार करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed is valmiki, the Lord of the rishis. He is the Master and the Lord of His `poem'. To Him, I bow down with all my eight bodies.

owis.original: वाल्मीक ऋषी बोलिला नसता । तरी आम्हांसी कैंची रामकथा । म्हणोनियां समर्था । काय म्हणोनि वर्णावें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वाल्मीकि ऋषीनें रामायण गायिलें नसतें तर आम्हाला रामकथा मिळाली नसती. अशा या थोर वाल्मीकिचे वर्णन करावें तितकें थोडेंच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: If valmiki the rishi and this `speech' are not, then how can we ever know this `story' of ram? Then how could our Master ever be praised? (This `speech' is the praise of the Master)

owis.original: रघुनाथकीर्ति प्रगट केली । तेणें तयाची महिमा वाढली । भक्तमंडळी सुखी जाली । श्रवणमात्रें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रीरामाचे यश गाऊन त्याची कीर्ति प्रगट केली त्यामुळें वाल्मीकिचा मोठेपणा वाढला. रामाची यशकीर्ति ऐकून भक्तमंडळीं सुखी झाली.
owis.englishMeaning: But if this pervasiveness of ram becomes apparent (`I am everything, everywhere') then, your greatness will go on increasing and due to merely listening to this `speech', this place of the devotee will be full of joy (ie. sat/existence, chid/knowledge and ananda/joy)

owis.original: आपुला काळ सार्थक केला । रघुनाथकीर्तिमधें बुडाला । भूमंडळीं उधरिला । बहुत लोक ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रीरामाच्या कीर्तिमध्यें डुंबल्यानें वाल्मीकिनें आपला काळ सार्थकीं लावला. आणि त्याबरोबर जगांत पुष्कळ लोकांचा उद्धार झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: Our time has been fulfilled when in the pervasiveness of ram we are absorbed. Then this world of the `all' has been lifted out from within this gross creation (and hell becomes heaven).

owis.original: रघुनाथभक्त थोर थोर । महिमा जयांचा अपार । त्या समस्तांचा किंकर । रामदास म्हणे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्यांचा महिमा अपार आहे. असे थोर थोर श्रीरामभक्त होऊन गेले. श्रीरामदास म्हणतात कीं, त्या सर्व भक्तांचा मी दास आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: ramdas says, "The devotee of ram is the `greatest of the great' when, this grandeur of `I am' becomes that limitless paramatma. Otherwise that paramatma is just a slave to the mind." Note: valmiki became the Lord of the `poem', he became ram, the Master. The `story' of ram is His avatar. It is the `I am' understanding and the ramayan shows us how to attain this. Otherwise it is just a story and this worldly life of desires and concepts will not go off. And all these are within you. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Surya Stavan Nirupan (A Discourse in Praise of the Sun)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: धन्य धन्य हा सूर्यवौंश । सकळ वौंशामधें विशेष । मार्तंडमंडळाचा प्रकाश । फांकला भूमंडळीं ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व वंशांमध्यें विशेष असणारा असा हा सूर्यवंश धन्य आहे. सूर्यमंडळाचा प्रकाश जगांत पसरलेला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed is thoughtlessness and the family of this Sun. In this family there is this `all' of that pure sattwa guna. The light of this Sun then spread upon the face of this world (by Its light ie. knowledge, the world is revealed).

owis.original: सोमाआंगीं आहे लांछन । पक्षा येका होय क्षीण । रविकिर्ण फांकतां आपण । कळाहीन ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चंद्रबिंबावर कलंक आढळतो. महिन्याच्या एका पंधरवड्यांत तो क्षीण होतो. शिवाय सूर्य उगवला कीं, त्याच्या किरणांनीं चंद्र निस्तेज होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The *moon within this `all' body is discoloured and when this moon grows dark (ie. dull with ignorance) then, that One pure knowledge gets completely destroyed. But if the rays of that Sun shine in all directions then, the moon's ability to know diminishes (we say, "We know" but that ability belongs to that purush with knowledge). *(The moon is a metaphor for the mind. In the darkness of ignorance it appears in the emptiness of sky but, it has borrowed its light from the rays of the Sun/purush)

owis.original: याकारणें सूर्यापुढें । दुसरी साम्यता न घडे । जयाच्या प्रकाशें उजेडे । प्राणीमात्रासी ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या कारणानें दुसरा कोणी सूर्याची बरोबरी करुं शकत नाहीं. सूर्याच्या प्रकाशानें सर्व प्राण्यांना उजाडते.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' appears after the Sun and in this `I am', that pure knowledge is not understood. And then due to this light of `I am', `many' objects are illuminated in the prana.

owis.original: नाना धर्म नाना कर्में । उत्तमें मध्यमें अधमें । सुगमें दुर्गमें नित्य नेमें । सृष्टीमधें चालती ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उत्तम, मध्यम, अधम, सुगम आणी दुर्गम अशा प्रकारचे अनेक धर्म आणि अनेक कर्मे अगदी नियमानें जगांत चालत असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: And then there are the `many' dharmas and the `many' karmas, due to the su- perior, middle and inferior gunas. Still understand that it is because of this easily attained knowledge and that very difficult to attain pure knowledge (ie. knowledge is prakruti/purush and pure knowledge is that thoughtless Reality), that the `many' practices and customs are carried out in the world.

owis.original: वेदशास्त्रें आणी पुराणें । मंत्र यंत्र नाना साधनें । संध्या स्नान पूजाविधानें । सूर्येविण बापुडीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें वेद, शास्त्रें, पुराणें, मंत्र, यंत्र नाना साधनें, संध्यास्नान, पूजेचे प्रकार या सार्‍या गोष्टी सूर्यावर अवलंबून असतात. सूर्य नसेल तर या सर्व गोष्टी लटक्या पडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: In this world there are the vedas, shasthras and puranas; the `many' mantras, sym- bolic diagrams and sadhanas; there is the time of worship, the purifying bath and the performance of puja (ie. all the duties of the brahmin priest). But these would not be possible without that Sun.

owis.original: नाना योग नाना मतें । पाहों जातां असंख्यातें । जाती आपुलाल्या पंथें । सूर्यउदय जालियां ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भिन्न योग व भिन्न मतें पाहूं गेल्यावर ती असंख्यांत आहेत. असें समजतें. सूर्य उदय पावला कीं त्यांना गती मिळतें. व ती आपापल्या मार्गांनीं चालूं लागतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' yogas and the `many' opinions when the Sun has arisen. And if you try to understand that immeasurable paramatma, then your path will be revealed by the rising of that Sun. (The Sun is always there. It is only the ignorant who say, "The sun has arisen")

owis.original: प्रपंचिकअथवा परमार्थिक । कार्य करणें कोणीयेक । दिवसेंविण निरार्थक । सार्थक नव्हे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कार्य कोणतेही असो, प्रापंचिकअसो वा पारमार्थिक असो, तें करायचें असेल तर त्यास दिवसा उजेडीं करावें लागतें. दिवस आणि सूर्यप्रकाश नसेल तर तें नीट होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Whether the actions performed are of prapanch or paramarth, still that One who resides within everyone is there (ie. in prapanch the action is offered to and received by the One, but this is not understood by the ignorant. In paramarth the action is offered to and received by the One and this is understood). Without that One Sun the fulfilment of life is not possible.

owis.original: सूर्याचें अधिष्ठान डोळे । डोळे नसतां सर्व आंधळे । याकारणें कांहींच न चले । सूर्येविण ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्राणिमात्रांच्या डोळ्यामध्यें सूर्याचे अधिष्ठान आहे. डोळे नसतील तर सगळा आंधळेपणा होतो. या कारणानें सूर्यावाचून कांहींच चालत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This knowledge is the *eyes of that Sun. If these eyes are not, then that Reality is blind. On account of this `speech', there is this `thing' but it does not begin without the Sun. *(That Reality uses knowledge; otherwise it is blind ie. ignorant jiva)

owis.original: म्हणाल अंध कवित्वें करिती । तरी हेहि सूर्याचीच गती । थंड जालियां आपुली मती । मग मतिप्रकाश कैचा ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यावर कोणी म्हणेल कीं, अहो आंधळी माणसें काव्यरचना करतात. पण हा देखील सूर्याचाच प्रभाव आहे. आपली बुद्धि जर थंड पडली तर मग तिच्यामध्यें ज्ञानाचा प्रकाश आढळणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: It may be said that the blind compose this poem (ie. this `story' of ram). But even this state `I am' also belongs to that thoughtless Sun (so in truth, everything is that Reality and it is that Reality that is seeking to return to Its Self). However if coldness comes to your understanding (ie. ignorance) then, how can there be this light of understanding?

owis.original: उष्ण प्रकाश तो सूर्याचा । शीत प्रकाश तो चंद्राचा । उष्णत्व नस्तां देह्याचा । घात होये ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूर्याचा प्रकाश उष्ण असतो तर चंद्राचा प्रकाश थंड असतो. शरीरांत उष्णता नसेल तर शरीर जगणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Heat (ie. knowing) comes from the light of that Sun and cold comes from the light of the moon. Therefore without the heat of the Sun, the body would simply perish.

owis.original: याकारणें सूर्येविण । सहसा न चले कारण । श्रोते तुम्ही विचक्षण । शोधून पाहा ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यावरुन असें दिसतें कीं, सूर्यावांचून जगांत कोणतेंच कार्य चालत नाहीं. तुम्ही चिकित्सक श्रोते आहात. तुमचे तुम्हीच हें शोधून बघावें.
owis.englishMeaning: This `I am' is the cause of creation. But without that Sun this cannot even begin. Therefore you who have become wise and by listening should search out and understand that Sun.

owis.original: हरिहरांच्या अवतारमूर्ती । शिवशक्तीच्या अनंत वेक्ती । यापूर्वीं होता गभस्ती । आतां हि आहे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगामध्यें हरिहरांचे अनेक अवतार झालें. शिव आणि शक्ति अनेक रुपांनी दृश्यांत आले. पण त्यासर्वांच्या पूर्वी सूर्य होता. तसाच तो आतांहि आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this `I am' of *harihara and it is that endless paramatma manifesting as shiva/shakti. But before this `I am', the Sun was and now also That is. *(vishnu and mahesh are said to have come together to find brahman; ie. forgetting is remembering)

owis.original: जितुके संसारासी आले । तितुके सूर्याखालें वर्तले । अंतीं देहे त्यागून गेले । प्रभाकरादेखतां ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें कांहीं या संसारांत दृश्यरुप धारण करुन आलें, त्या सर्वांचा आरंभ आणी शेवट सूर्याच्या नजरेखालींच झाला. संसारांत आलेले प्राणी अखेर सूर्याच्या देखतच देह सोडून गेले.
owis.englishMeaning: All those who came into samsar have lived and have had their lives under this Sun. And in the end they went by leaving their body in this Sun's presence.

owis.original: चंद्र ऐलीकडे जाला । क्षीरसागरीं मधून काढिला । चौदा रत्नांमधें आला । बंधु लक्षुमीचा ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चंद्राचा जन्म अलिकडचा आहे. क्षीरसागर घुसळून त्यांतून त्यास काढला आहे. एकंदर चौदा रत्नें जीं निघालीं, त्यांत हा लक्ष्मीचा बंधू निघाला.
owis.englishMeaning: The moon (ie. mind) is on this side and it is limited. It was one of the fourteen jewels that had come up from the churning of the *ocean of milk and it is the brother of goddess lakshmi. *(The ocean of milk is the place of vishnu/knowledge. It is said that the gods and demons churned this ocean and fourteen jewels came out of it. The first jewel was lakshmi, `I am'. A pure mind freed of names and forms and concepts that make it impure)

owis.original: विश्र्वचक्षु हा भास्कर । ऐसें जाणती लाहानथोर । याकारणें दिवाकर । श्रेष्ठांहून श्रेष्ठ ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूर्य हा विश्र्वाचा डोळा आहे. ही गोष्ट सारे लहानथोर जाणतात. म्हणून सूर्य श्रेष्ठांहून श्रेष्ठ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: These eyes of knowledge from which the whole creation came are, in truth, that thoughtless Sun. Due to this knowledge, that great brahman within the small jiva knows and due to this knowledge, the Sun, the `most excellent of the most excellent' is realized.

owis.original: अपार नभमार्ग क्रमणें । ऐसेंचि प्रत्यहीं येणें जाणें । या लोकोपकाराकारणें । आज्ञा समर्थाची ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूर्य अपार आकाश मार्गानें चालतो. रोज त्याचें त्या मार्गानें येणें व जाणें चालतें. हा लोकोपकार करावा अशी सूर्याला भगवंताची आज्ञा आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When that limitless paramatma traverses this path through the sky *everyday then, there is the coming and going of knowledge. This knowledge is the protector of the world and it is under the orders of that paramatma. *(Everyday you wake up and the rays of that Sun shine and everyday you go to sleep when the rays of the Sun set. Everyday knowledge awakes and knowledge goes to sleep when ignorance comes).

owis.original: दिवस नस्तां अंधकार । सर्वांसी नकळें सारासार । दिवसेंविण तश्कर । कां दिवाभीत पक्षी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दिवस नसेल तर अंधार असतो. अंधारामधें सर्वांना सारासार नीटपणें कळत नाहीं. दिवस नसून अंधार असेल तर चोर आणि घुबड यांना बरें वाटतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When the Sun is not present then, there is darkness (ignorance) and this `all' cannot know that thoughtless essence (maharaj- knowledge must go off before ignorance can come). Without the Sun there is *`stealing' and the opinions of the ignorant. *(The mind is the thief, it steals this knowledge and uses it as his own)

owis.original: सूर्यापुढें आणिक दुसरें । कोण आणावें सामोरें । तेजोरासी निर्द्धारें । उपमेरहित ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तुलनेसाठीं सूर्यापुढें दुसर्‍या कोणाला आणतां येणार नाहीं. सूर्य तेजाची राशी आहे त्याला दुसरी उपमा नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Anything after the Sun is due to this knowledge. But who is there who can bring this knowledge into the Sun's presence? Due to this Sun, that requires no support and is without comparison, there is the brilliance of fire (ie. knowing of something outside of myself).

owis.original: ऐसा हा सविस्तर सकळांचा । पूर्वज होय रघुनाथाचा । अगाध महिमा मानवी वाचा । काये म्हणोनि वर्णावी ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असा हा सूर्य सगळ्यांचा आहे. श्रीरामाचा तर तो पूर्वज आहे. त्याचा महिमा अगाध आहे. माणूस आपल्या वाणीनें त्याचे वर्णन करुं शकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is that thoughtless Sun of this `all'. He is the eldest of the ancestor's of ram. Its unfathomable greatest has become this para speech within man; but why should it be outwardly expressed? (Why should there be the gross speech of vaikhari? Just remain with this para, `I am')

owis.original: रघुनाथवौंश पूर्वापर । येकाहूनि येक थोर । मज मतिमंदार हा विचार । काये कळे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रीरामाचा वंश पूर्वापार चालत आला आहे. त्यामध्यें एकापेक्षां एक थोर पुरुष होऊन गेले . माझ्यासारख्या मतिमंदाला सूर्यवंशाची कल्पना येणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This ancestor of ram is beyond the beginning of time (ie. prakruti). But from that One brahman there has come another, this knowledge `I am'. But how can my dull mind understand thoughtlessness?

owis.original: रघुनाथाचा समुदाव । तेथें गुंतला अंतर्भाव । म्हणोनि वर्णितां महत्व । वाग्दुर्बळ मी ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या ठिकाणी श्रीरामभक्तांचा समुदाय असतो. तेथें माझे अंतरंग गुंतलेले असते. म्हणून त्याचें वर्णन माझ्या दुर्बळ वाणीला करणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is this gathering together of knowledge then, brahman has been caught in this understanding `I am'. But this weak utterance of `I' has no ability to describe His greatness.

owis.original: सकळ दोषाचा परिहार । करितां सूर्यास नमस्कार । स्फूर्ति वाढे निरंतर । सूर्यदर्शन घेतां ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूर्याला नमस्कार केला तर सर्व दोष नाहींसे होतात. सूर्य दर्शन घेत गेल्यानें स्फूर्ति निरंतर वाढत जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: Still by bowing down and surrendering to that Sun, this fault of the `all' is given to His care. That parabrahman has expanded as this original inspiration `I am'. Therefore accept this knowledge of that Sun. (This knowledge is not that Sun but it has come from Him and therefore one should accept this) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Prithvi Stavan Nirupan (A Discourse in Praise of the Earth)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: धन्य धन्य हे वसुमती । इचा महिमा सांगों किती । प्राणीमात्र तितुके राहाती । तिच्या आधारें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही पृथ्वी खरोखरीच धन्य होय. हिचा महिमा सांगावा तेवढा थोडाच आहे. अगदी सगळे प्राणी तिच्या आधारानें राहतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed is this great element earth when these `many' thoughts have understood the greatness of thoughtlessness. But if there are only the `many' thoughts then, that One has to stay in only the prana with only the support of this earth.

owis.original: अंतरीक्ष राहाती जीव । तोहि पृथ्वीचा स्वभाव । देहे जड नस्तां जीव । कैसे तगती ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आकाशांत राहणार्‍या जीवांनासुद्धा पृथ्वीचाच आधार असतो. कारण देह पृथ्वी तत्वाचा बनलेल असतो. आणि देजावाचून जीव जगूं शकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: That One who stays as the sky has become a jiva and then, He is of the nature of this earth element (that atma is everything, everywhere. He is the space upon which the other four elements appear. And He is the earth, the jiva etc. on account of objectivity). But if there were no gross bodies then, how could that One stay as a jiva? (If the gross is negated then that One would stay as shiva)

owis.original: जाळिती पोळिती कुदाळिती । नांगरिती उकरिती खाणती । मळ मूत्र तिजवरी करिती । आणी वमन ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोक पृथ्वीला जाळतात, पोळतात कुदळीनें खणतात, नांगरतात, उकरतात खणून काढतात. तिच्यावर मलमूत्र टाकतात व ओकतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Here that One is tormented and worries and gets injured; It gets insulted and quarrels and grieves and gets beaten and treated badly. And upon this earth that One discharges its bowels and vomits.

owis.original: नासकें कुजकें जर्जर । पृथ्वीविण कैची थार । देह्यांतकाळीं शरीर । तिजवरी पडे ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नासके, कुजके, अति जीर्ण झालेल्या पदार्थांना पृथ्वीचाच आधार असतो. अंतकाळीं प्राण्याचा देह पृथ्वीवरच पडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Here that One is easily damaged and meets with insincerity and deceit and then gets worn out with age. As a jiva, what support has It got other than this earth? (The gross, ignorant and objective gets only the support of the gross, ignorant and objective) And when this gross body comes to an end then, this `all' body falls down upon this earth (ie. if the jiva has gained no understanding of this `all' body during its lifetime then, at the time of death, how can any understanding possibly come? Due to our strong body attachment, this `all' has come tumbling down into the body and it will disappear in this ignorance we call death).

owis.original: बरें वाईट सकळ कांहीं । पृथ्वीविण थार नाहीं । नाना धातु द्रव्य तें हि । भूमीचे पोटीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळें बरें-वाईट जें आहे त्याला पृथ्वीचाच आधार असतो. अनेक धातु व द्रव्यें पृथ्वीच्याच पोटांत सापडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One is a jiva then, the best (ie. thoughtless nirgun) and the worst (ie. body consciousness) and this `all thing' (ie. sagun) have no support other than this earth element. Still, within the belly of this earth element, there are the `many' dhatus (ie. basic substances that make up the gross body) and the `many' wealths and that Reality also (it all depends on where we place our attention and to what we are dedicated to).

owis.original: येकास येक संव्हारिती । प्राणी भूमीवरी असती । भूमी सांडून जाती । कोणीकडे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एकमेकांनी एकमेकांचा संहार केला तरी ते दोघेही पृथ्वीवेच असतात. पृथ्वी सोडून दुसरीकडे कोणीं जाऊंच शकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When the one jiva destroys that One then, the atma exists in the prana upon this earth. Then where can It go when this earth is left? (Then it can only go to ignorance maharaj- the ignorant think that without a body they cannot live)

owis.original: गड कोट पुरें पट्टणें । नाना देश कळती अटणें । देव दानव मानव राहाणें । पृथ्वीवरी ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गड, कोट, गांवें, आणि शहरें, आणी नाना प्रकारचे देश, पृथ्वीवरच आहेत. प्रवास केला म्हणजे ते कळतात. देव, दानव आणि मानव यांचे राहणें पृथ्वीवरच असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: There are forts, castles, towns and cities and the `many' states and places are un- derstood due to objectification. And as long as there is this earth then, there are gods, demons and mankind (as long as the objective world remains then there will be the three states of waking state/man, dream/gods and deep sleep/demons).

owis.original: नाना रत्नें हिरे परीस । नाना धातु द्रव्यांश । गुप्त प्रगट कराव्यास । पृथ्वीविण नाहीं ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाना प्रकारची रत्नें, हिरे, परिस अनेक प्रकारचे धातु आणि द्रव्यें पृथ्वीमध्यें गुप्त असतात. त्यांना प्रगट करण्यास पृथ्वीखेरीजमार्ग नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' jewels and diamonds and there is this magic paris stone (ie. that turns iron to *gold). There are the `many' dhatus and there is that essence of these things. Still that hidden purush does not become apparent without this earth element (objectification brings this illusory world and that purush becomes a man. And by vivek that man becomes that purush). *(The understanding that makes man into knowledge)

owis.original: मेरुमांदार हिमाचळ । नाना अष्टकुळाचळ । नाना पक्षी मछ व्याळ । भूमंडळीं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मेरु, मांदार, हिमालय तसेंच आठ कुलाचल पर्वत, नाना प्रकारचे पक्षी, मासे, आणि सर्प यांचा आधारही पृथ्वीच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this earth element there is meru mountain (ie. `I am'), the himalayan moun- tains (ie. causal body) and the eight divisions of the `many' creatures. They are the `many' birds, fish, reptiles, etc. (this `I am' is sometimes called the supra-causal body, for it is the cause of this whole existence. The forgetting of this is the ignorance that causes body consciousness. And from this causal body of ignorance there comes `many' creatures. All this is within your body depending on where you place your attention. See 4.10.1-9)

owis.original: नाना समुद्रापैलीकडे । भोंवतें आवर्णोदका कडें । असंभाव्य तुटले कडे । भूमंडळाचे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक समुद्रांपलीकडे पृथ्वीच्या सभोवती असलेल्या आवर्णोदकाकडे पृथ्वीचे मोठमोठे तुटलेले कडे आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' thoughts and there is this ocean of knowledge beyond. There is the ring of controlling waters (ie. great water element) enwrapping this great earth and together they break that unattainable Self into many pieces. (The water element is the beginning of individual names and forms and due to the earth element these forms become gross; and if one becomes less and less objective then this ocean of knowledge ie. `all' can be attained)

owis.original: त्यामधें गुप्त विवरें । लाहानथोरें अपारें । तेथें निबिड अंधकारें । वस्ती कीजे ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यामध्यें लहानमोठी अशी खूप गुप्त विवरें आहेत. त्या विवरांच्यामध्यें अगदी गाढ अंधार भरलेला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: If that hidden purush within these `many' pieces is investigated then, this small jiva within that great brahman becomes the limitless paramatma. But brahman is pervaded by dense darkness when placed within these objects of the great earth element (the ignorance of the causal body or avidya maya is the pervading darkness).

owis.original: आवर्णोदक तें अपार । त्याचा कोण जाणे पार । उदंड दाटले जळचर । असंभाव्य मोठे ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आवरणोदक इतकें अपार आहे कीं त्याचा अंतच लागत नाहीं. त्यामध्यें प्रचंड शरीराचे जलचर पुष्कळच आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When these controlling waters enwrapping this earth become that endless para- matma then, who can know the end of That? When that vast paramatma completely pervades this *`water creature' it is called the antar-atma but at the same time, It is still that great unattainable paramatma. *(Soft formation of a world of forms)

owis.original: त्या जीवनास आधार पवन । निबिड दाट आणी घन । फुटों शकेना जीवनसा । कोणेकडे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या आवरणोदकाला वार्‍याचा आधार आहे. हा वायु गहन दाट आणि घट्ट आहे. म्हणून तें पाणी कोणत्याहि बाजूनें वाहून जात नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: The wind that supports these waters is dense and pervading and under the control of this wind, it is not possible for these waters to be scattered (when this knowing is understood then, objectivity does not arise to scatter this `all' into different forms)

owis.original: त्या प्रभंजनासी आधार । कठीणपणें अहंकार । ऐसा त्या भूगोळाचा पार । कोण जाणे ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्या वायूला आधार आहे घट्ट व कठीण अहंकाराचा. हा अहंकार जड द्रव्याचा म्हणजे पृथ्वीचा बनलेला आहे. असा त्या भूगोलाचा विस्तार कोणीच जाणत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But as the support of this wind is the hardness of the ahankar (ie. `I am'; hardness means some ignorance is there and ignorance means something other is there), then how can that no-otherness of the atma, on the other side of this earth, be known?

owis.original: नाना पदार्थांच्या खाणी । धातुरत्नांच्या दाटणी । कल्पतरु चिंतामणी । अमृतकुंडें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीवर अनेक पदार्थांच्या खाणीं आहेत. त्यांत खूप धातु व रत्नें आहेत. शिवात कल्पतरु, चिंतामणि आणि अमृतकुंडे पृथ्वीवरच आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma is the source of `many' objects and It is the source of this one `object'. That One is pervading the `many' dhatus (the essential ingredients of the body) and the `many' jewels. That atma is the reservoir of this immortal nectar of `I am'. It is the *wish-fulfilling tree and the thought-relieving stone (ie. knowledge- it dispels the `many' thoughts). *(Whatever you think you are, this knowledge becomes that; whatever you imagine something to be, this knowledge becomes that)

owis.original: नाना दीपें नाना खंडें । वसती उद्वसें उदंडे । तेथें नाना जीवनाचीं बंडें । वेगळालीं ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक बेटें आहेत. अनेक खंडे आहेत. त्यावर अगदी ओसाड प्रदेश आहे तसाच अनेक प्रकारच्या जीवप्राण्यांनी भरलेला प्रदेश आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' divisions of creatures and the `many' divisions of lands then, that vast paramatma stays in confusion. But `there' the `many' commotions cre- ated by these waters of objectification are passed over.

owis.original: मेरुभोवते कडे कापले । असंभाव्य कडोसें पडिलें । निबिड तरु लागले । नाना जिनसी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मेरुभोवती कापलेले कडे आहेत. त्यांतून पुष्कळ कवडसे पडतात. नाना पदार्थांचे भरपूर वृक्ष उगवलेले आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Surrounding this meru mountain are cliffs where pilgrims gather (ie. sadhaks) and the rays of light ie. knowledge, from that *unattainable paramatma fall there. But in the darkness, there is a thick forest where the `many' trees grow and `many' objects appear (this world is like a dark forest and if the rays of light do not penetrate it then, there is only the darkness of ignorance, of body identification. And then like ram lost in the forest, you will ask the objects of this world to give you happiness/sita). *(He is unattainable because as long as you remain, He cannot be attained)

owis.original: त्यासन्निध लोकालोक । जेथें सूर्याचे फिरे चाक । चंद्रादि द्रोणाद्रि मैनाक । माहां गिरी ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याच्याजवळ लोकालोक पर्वत आहे. तेथें सूर्याचे चक्र फिरत असते. चंद्रपर्वत, द्रोणपर्वत, मैनाक असे मोठे पर्वत आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Near this meru mountain there is this world of the worldly and this world gets illuminated by the passage of the *Sun. Then there are the great mountains such as the `mountain of the moon', the mountains by the name drona and mainaka.3 *(See 16.2.16; when that limitless paramatma transverses the sky, there is the rising and falling of knowledge everyday)

owis.original: नाना देशीं पाषाणभेद । नाना जिनसी मृतिकाभेद । नाना विभूति छंद बंद । नाना खाणी ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या देशांत निरनिराळें दगड आहेत. निरनिराळ्या प्रकारची माती आहे. नाना प्रकारच्या विभूति आहेत. छंद आहेत. बंद खाणी आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the `many' states are the `many' different stones (ie. bodies);4 within the `many' objects are the `many' different clays (ie. everything is made up of dirt only). Then the `many' likings and longings bind that Great Ascetic (ie. He wants nothing from this world) and there are the `many' places of birth.

owis.original: बहुरत्न हे वसुंदरा । ऐसा पदार्थ कैचा दुसरा । अफाट पडिलें सैरावैंरा । जिकडे तिकडे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यामुळेंच पृथ्वीला " बहुरत्न वसुंधरा " म्हणतात. पृथ्वीसारखा दुसरा पदार्थ नाहीं. पृथ्वी जिकडे तिकडे अफाट पसरलेली आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless Self becomes the `many' *jewels of the world, then how can there be this `object' of the `all' (one of the the real jewels)? For its pervasiveness has tumbled down and there is confusion everywhere. *(maharaj- to a Saint, a diamond and a lump of hard shit, are the same)

owis.original: अवघी पृथ्वी फिरोन पाहे । ऐसा प्राणी कोण आहे । दुजी तुळणा न साहे । धरणीविषीं ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळ्या पृथ्वीवर प्रवास करुन ती पाहणारा कोणीच माणूस नाहीं. पृथ्वीशी तुलना करतां येईल असा दुसरा पदार्थ नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Who is there in the prana who has turned this earth element that is absorbed in everything, towards this `all' (ie. who has forgot everything)? For this `all' cannot be compared to someone who holds attraction for the sensual objects.

owis.original: नाना वल्ली नाना पिकें । देसोदेसीं अनेकें । पाहों जातां सारिख्या सारिखें । येक हि नाहीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या देशांत निरनिराळ्या वनस्पति व पिकें असतात. पाहावयास गेलें तर त्यापैकी एकासारखें एक नसतें.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' creepers (ie. from one thought so many things are produced) and the `many' fruits (ie. pleasures and pains) and due to the numerous different forms, there are so many different places. And even when you try to understand then, this `all' is established but this is also not that One.

owis.original: स्वर्ग मृत्यु आणी पाताळें । अपूर्व रचिलीं तीन ताळें । पाताललोकीं माहां व्याळें । वस्ती कीजे ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वर्ग, मृत्यु व पाताळ अशी तीन ताळें त्यानें रचिली आहेत. पाताळांत प्रचंड सर्पांची वस्ती आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: There is heaven, this world where death reigns and the nether-worlds. That which has never been seen (thoughtless) has arranged these three worlds.5 Therefore in the nether-worlds, that great serpent shesha should be made to stay (ie. when this world/waking state is not, we call this sleep and say nothing was there. But some- one must have been there, otherwise we would not know who we are when we awake. shesha, that which remains when everything is negated; That which cannot be negated was there. The Witness of this ignorance or nothing or sleep, who remains when nothing was there is called shesha. And when you use vivek ie. sleep to this world, then you become shesha)6

owis.original: नाना वल्ली बीजांची खाणी । ते हे विशाळ धरणी । अभिनव कर्त्याची करणी । होऊन गेली ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही अति विशाळ पृथ्वी म्हणजे नाना प्रकारच्या वनस्पतिंच्या बीजांची खाणच आहे. अंतरात्म्याची ही मोठी विलक्षण करणी होऊन गेली.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' creepers and that source of this `all' seed. There is that vast thoughtless Self and this earth and there is this marvellous action (ie. `all') of the `doer' going on.

owis.original: गड कोठ नाना नगरें । पुरें पट्टणें मनोहरें । सकळां ठाईं जगदेश्र्वरें । वस्ती कीजे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गड, कोट, अनेक गांवें आणि लहान मोठी सुंदर शहरें, या सर्वांमध्यें जगदीश्र्वराची वस्ती असते.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the forts and castles and `many' towns; when there are the capti- vating villages and cities then, that Lord of the world should be made to reside in this place of the `all' (when there is an objective world then, the understanding of purush and prakruti is required).

owis.original: माहां बळी होऊन गेले । पृथ्वीवरी चौताळले । सामर्थ्यें निराळे राहिले । हें तों घडेना ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पूर्वी अतिशय बलवान पुरुष होऊन गेले. या पृथ्वीवरच मोठा पराक्रम गाजविला. व स्वसामर्थ्यानें पृथ्वीहून निराळे राहिले असें कांहीं झालें नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Very powerful people have been and gone and on this earth they ranted and raved. But even if one remains separate from this earth by the power of this `I am' still, that thoughtless Self has not been gained.

owis.original: असंभाव्य हे जगती । जीव कितीयेक जाती । नाना अवतारपंगती । भूमंडळावरी ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही पृथ्वी पुनः अशी होण्याचा संभव नाहीं. या पृथ्वीवर असंख्य जीव होऊन जातात. अनेक अवतारसुद्धा या भूमंडळावर झालें.
owis.englishMeaning: That unattainable thoughtless Self is within this world and the jiva and its lineage are that One who is within these `many' (see V.1). And on this earth when there are the `many' jivas still there is the companionship of this `I am'.

owis.original: सध्यां रोकडे प्रमाण । कांहीं करावा नलगे अनुमान । नाना प्रकारीचें जीवन । पृथ्वीचेनि आधारें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आजसुद्धा असा पुरावा आहे कीं, पृथ्वीच्या आधारानेंच नाना प्रकारचे जीव जीवन जगतात. त्यासाठीं कांहीं कल्पना करण्याचे कारण नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: And when there is this ever-present `I am'/sagun then there is that nirgun nearby. When this `thing' is created by you then, conjecture is no longer required. Otherwise there will be these great waters and then with the support of this earth, there will be the `many' living forms (the concept of `many' arose on account of objectification).

owis.original: कित्येक भूमी माझी म्हणती । सेवटीं आपणचि नरोन जाती । कित्येक काळ होतां जगती । जैसी तैसी ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं लोक जमीन माझी असें म्हणतात. शेवटीं आपणच मरुन जातात. पण कितीही काळ गेला तरी पृथ्वी जशींच्या तशींच राहातें.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that One within the `many' is a jiva and says, "This is my world", but in the end, it dies and goes away. Still within this world there is this `time and space'* and that One within the `many' is as It always is (either be a jiva and live and die or seek out this knowledge that is the support of the jiva thought and then become that One who resides within everyone. Only such understanding brings an end to birth and death). *(maharaj- when you wake up, space is there and where there is space, knowledge must be there).

owis.original: ऐसा पृथ्वीचा महिमा । दुसरी काये द्यावी उपमा । ब्रह्मादिकापासुनी आम्हां । आश्रयोचि आहे ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीचा महिमा हा असा आहे. तिला दुसरी उपमा देतां येत नाहीं. ब्रह्मादिकांपासून थेट आमच्यापर्यंत सर्वांना पृथ्वीचाच आधार आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The greatness of this earth element is within this knowledge. What can be compared to That? (Its greatness is the atma and that can be attained when we stop objectifying; see V.1). Then we are protected from lord brahma etc. for we are beyond the three gunas. Note: Mountains are concepts and the golden mountain is `I am'. The earth/prithvi is the beginning of gross body consciousness but is also the place where we can start to leave of such thinking if we understand that within every great element there is this mula maya and within this mula maya there is knowledge, existence, the unmanifest gunas and elements and also that thoughtless swarup. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Aap Nirupan (A Discourse on the Water Element)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: आतां सकळांचें जन्मस्थान । सकळ जीवांचें जीवन । जयास आपोनारायेण । ऐसें बोलिजे ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाणी सकळ जीवांचे जन्मस्थान आहे. सर्व जीवांचे जगणें त्यावर अवलंबून असते. पाण्यास आपोनारायण असें म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Now (ie. being in this present endless moment) is the birth place of this `all'. But if this `all' becomes the water element then, there is the birthplace of the jiva (objectification brings the jiva but it cannot live without this `I am'). This objectification should be put to an end by this `speech' of mula maya.

owis.original: पृथ्वीस आधार आवर्णोदक । सप्तसिंधूचें सिंधोदक । नाना मेधीचें मेधोदक । भूमंडळीं चालिलें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीला आवरणोदकाचा आधार आहे. पृथ्वीवर सात समुद्रांचे पाणी आहे. तसेंच पावसाचें पाणी वाहात असते.
owis.englishMeaning: The earth element is supported by these *controlling waters or the seven seas surroun- ding this earth. And then, when the rain waters (ie. thoughts and desires) from the clouds of avidya maya fall, `many' forms appear on this earth. *(There is this soft cre- ation, arising like a wave on the ocean. Then due to the desire for the fruits of past actions, you become body conscious and this `soft' creation becomes hard and very objective)

owis.original: नाना नद्या नाना देसीं । वाहात मिळाल्या सागरासी । लाहानथोर पुण्यरासी । अगाध महिमे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या देशांतील नद्या वाहात वाहात अखेर समुद्राला जाऊन मिळतात. नद्या कमी जास्त पुण्याच्या समजाव्यात. कांहीं नद्यांचा महिमा अगाध आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: These `many' *rivers in the `many' places are all flowing to meet the ocean. That ocean is the great brahman within the small jiva and It is the unfathomable great store of merit. *(See 11.7 The moving river; when this river of knowledge comes tumbling downwards from this great mountain of `I am' then, it becomes the `many' rivers and they say, "I am so and so")

owis.original: नद्या पर्वतींहून कोंसळल्या । नाना सांकडीमधें रिचवल्या । धबाबां खळाळां चालिल्या । असंभाव्य ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नद्या पर्वतावरुन कोसळतात. दर्‍या, कपारी व खळगें यांच्यामधें त्या अडतात. आणि धबधब्यानें व खळखळाटानें वाहातात.
owis.englishMeaning: These rivers fall violently and confused from the mountain `I am' and they tumble into `many' difficulties. Then that unattainable Self gets caught in squabbling and toils.

owis.original: कूप बावी सरोवरें । उदंड तळीं थोरथोरें । निर्मळें उचंबळती नीरें । नाना देसीं ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आड, विहिरी, सरोवरें, अतिशय प्रचंड जलाशयें असतात. त्याचें स्वच्छ पाणी निरनिराळ्या देशांत उचंबळत असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Within the comparing and completing of the housebound wives and the robbers and murderers, there is that vast paramatma. But the purity of that `greatest of the great' has been clouded by these waters in the `many' places. (Conceptualisation is the birth- place of the jiva and as it flows downward/outwards, it acquires more characteristics and differences).

owis.original: गायेमुखें पाट जाती । नाना कालवे वाहाती । नाना झर्‍या झिरपती । झरती नीरें ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: गायमुखें, पाट, कालवे, अशा अनेक प्रकारांनी पाणी वाहात असते. अनेक ठिकाणीं झरींतून पाणी झिरपते. झरें झिरपत असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: From the mouth of the ganga (ie. river of knowledge) this water had set off and then, it flowed through the `many' canals (ie. limiting concepts). Then from the `many' springs, this water trickles out and then wastes away (each jiva is a small spring of this pure water).

owis.original: डुरें विहिरे पाझर । पर्वत फुटोन वाहे नीर । ऐसे उदकाचे प्रकार । भूमंडळीं ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पर्वत फुटुन पाण्याचे लहान जलसंचय तयार होतात. पाणदुरे पाझर वाहात राहातात. पृथ्वीवर पाण्याचे असें अनेक प्रकार आढळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Some wander aimlessly only for pleasure and in some places the water gushes out to be scattered by burdens and disagreements. Like this it is for the different forms created from this water element that is within this earth.

owis.original: जितुकें गिरी तितुक्या धारा । कोंसळती भयंकरा । पाभळ वाहाळा अपारा । उकळ्या सांडिती ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जितके डोंगर आहेत तितक्यावरुन प्रचंड पाण्याच्या धारा वाहातात. झरे व ओढे तर वाहात असतात. जमिनींतून कारंजासारखे उडणारे पाणीही सारखें उडत असते.
owis.englishMeaning: Whenever there is a mountain, then there is a stream of water flowing down ("I am a body" concept). It tumbles down violently causing great fear and dread. It is that limitless paramatma that has come tumbling down from Its own place and has gone flowing through the channels of endless longings and passions.

owis.original: भूमंडळीचें जळ आघवें । किती म्हणोनी सांगावें । नाना कारंजीं आणावें । बांधोनी पाणी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीवर आढळणार्‍या सार्‍या पाण्याचे वर्णन करणें शक्य नाहीं. नळ टाकून कारंजांत पाणी आणून सोडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This pure water has become the `many' things of the world and therefore the `many' thoughts should be made thoughtless and the `many' fountains and confined waters should be brought to the ocean.

owis.original: डोहो डबंकें खबाडीं टाकीं । नाना गिरिकंदरीं अनेकीं । नाना जळें नाना लोकीं । वेगळालीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: डोह, डबकीं, लहान टाकी, मोठी टाकीं, असे लहानमोठे जलाशय डोंगरामध्यें आढळतात. निरनिराळ्या देशांत पाणी निरनिराळें असते.
owis.englishMeaning: This pure water has become the deep dark waters and the `many' swallow puddles, ponds and created channels; this pure water is within the mountain cave (a hidden place within the "I am a body" concept) and within the numerous different shapes and forms. When there are these `many' waters in the *`many' worlds then, this pure water is being ignored. *(maharaj- every mind is a world)

owis.original: तीर्थें येकाहून येक । माहां पवित्र पुण्यदायक । अगाध महिमा शास्त्रकारक । बोलोनि गेले ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अतिशय पवित्र, आणि पुण्यदायक अशीं एकापेक्षां एक श्रेष्ठ तीर्थें आहेत. शास्त्रकारांनी त्यांचा फार मोठा महिमा वर्णन केला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this holy river of knowledge, that One is understood by the one (that one jiva becomes that One brahman when it maintains this `speech'). That nirgun is the most pure and He is the giver of great merit and His unfathomable greatness is `spoken' of by the writers of the shasthras (neti, neti).

owis.original: नाना तीर्थांचीं पुण्योदकें । नाना स्थळोस्थळीं सीतळोदकें । तैसींच नाना उष्णोदकें । ठाईं ठाईं ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक तीर्थांचे पाणी पुण्यदायक आहे. अनेक ठिकाणीं पाणी फार थंड आहे. तर अनेक ठिकाणीं पाणी फार गरम आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' waters are due to this sacred water of knowledge at that holy place of the `all'. There this water becomes cold due to ignorance and the `many' stay in `many' different places. But when that water is hot (due to the fire of knowing), then the `many' becomes this `all' (each element has two influences see 10.3.18; cold makes it become more gross and hot causes it to rise up and return back to its source).

owis.original: नाना वल्लीमधे जीवन । नाना फळीं फुलीं जीवन । नाना कंदीं मुळीं जीवन । गुणकारकें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व प्रकारच्या वेलींमध्यें, फळामध्यें व फुलांमध्यें पाणी असतेच. कांहीं कंदमुळांतींल पाणी गुणकारक असते.
owis.englishMeaning: This water of life (ie. gives life to the jiva) is within the `many' *creepers and this water of life is within the `many' flowers and their fruits (ie. experiences and pleasures and pains). But even when, due to the potency of the gunas, there are the `many' roots and bulbs still, this water of life is within them (on account of the mixing of sattwa, raja and tama, there is objectification and the `many' thoughts. Still all this needs the support of this water of life, `I am').8 *(From just one desire/thought, so many thoughts and experiences and pleasures and pains can sprout)

owis.original: क्षारोदकें सिंधोदकें । विषोदकें पियूषोदकें । नाना स्थळांतरीं उदकें । नाना गुणाचीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खारें, गोडें, विषारी, अमृतासारखें मधुर अशा प्रकारचे गुण असणारे पाण्याचे प्रकार निरनिराळ्या जागीं आढळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: 8Gospel of Thomas- Jesus said, "Blessed is the one who has toiled and has found life." 14. Due to this objectification, there is salty water, river water, poisonous water and nectar-like water. For this water element within the `many' places acquires so `many' qualities.

owis.original: नाना युक्षदंडाचे रस । नाना फळांचे नाना रस । नाना प्रकारीचे गोरस । मद पारा गुळत्र ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारचे उसाचे रस, निरनिराळ्या फळांचे रस, अनेक प्रकारचे गोरस, मादक रस, पारद रस, राब, काकवी व गुळपाणी हे गुळाचे तीन रस, असे पुष्कळ प्रकारचे रस आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' *thoughts then, there is the taste of sugarcane and the `many' tastes of the `many' fruits. Then there are the `many' tastes of the different sense organs and then there is wine, medicine and spicy concoctions (everything in this world comes from this water element ie. the minds habit to make name and form in the nameless and formless). *(Where is sweet or sour when the thought, sweet or sour, does not arise? maharaj- say everything is, "so so")

owis.original: नाना मुक्तफळांचें पाणी । नाना रत्नीं तळपे पाणी । नाना शस्त्रामधें पाणी । नाना गुणाचें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निरनिराळ्या मोत्यांत पाणी असते. निरनिराळ्या रत्नांचे पाणी झळकते. निरनिराळ्या हत्यारांना निरनिराळ्या गुणांचे पाणी असते.
owis.englishMeaning: This water has created the glow of the `many' pearls and the sparkle of the `many' jewels (the pearl does not glow nor does the jewel sparkle for a dog like they do for us, for it has no care for such things). And in these waters of the `many' learnings there are `many' qualities acquired.

owis.original: शुक्लीत श्रोणीत लाळ मूत्र स्वेद । नाना उदकाचे नाना भेद । विवरोन पाहातां विशद । होत जातें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रेत, रक्त, लाळ, मूत्र, घाम हे सगळे पण्याचेच प्रकार आहेत. त्यांच्यावर विचार केला कीं तें ध्यानांत येते.
owis.englishMeaning: There is blood, semen, saliva, urine and sweat when this great water is the `many' thoughts with there `many' differences. But when you investigate, you come to under- stand that there is only that pure vast swarup. (See 17.8.27, 28)

owis.original: उदकाचे देह केवळ । उदकाचेंचि भूमंडळ । चंद्रमंडळ सूर्यमंडळ । उदकाकरितां ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह पाण्यापासून बनतात. पृथ्वी पाण्यापासूनच झाली आहे. चंद्रमंडळ व  सूर्यमंडळ सूर्यापासूनच झाली आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that pure knowledge but, on account of these great waters of objectification there has come a gross body and the whole gross world. The disk of the moon and the disk of the sun are because of these great waters (ie. previous to this there is the oneness of this `all' form; `here' the sun and moon are not named and so, they do not exist as separate forms. In our bhajans it says, "The sun and moon fade away within your brilliance"; His brilliance is this knowing).9

owis.original: क्षारसिंधु क्षीरसिंधु । सुरासिंधु आज्यसिंधु । दधिसिंधु युक्षरससिंधु । शुद्ध सिंधु उदकाचा ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: खारा समुद्र, दुधाचा समुद्र, दारुचा समुद्र, तुपाचा समुद्र, दह्याचा समुद्र, उसाच्या रसाचा समुद्र, शुद्ध गोड पाण्याचा समुद्र,
owis.englishMeaning: The sea of salt water, the sea of milk, the sea of wine, the sea of ghee, the sea of curd, the sea of sugarcane juice and the sea of pure water, can all come from this great water (see 8.5.14-17 ie. sea of salt is seen by the people and the sea of pure water is paramatma; these are all states of different understandings; the sea of milk is knowledge, the abode of vishnu; curds and ghee come from this milk).

owis.original: ऐसें उदक विस्तारलें । मुळापासून सेवटा आलें । मधेंहि ठाईं ठाईं उमटलें । ठाईं ठाईं गुप्त ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें पाणी जिकडे तिकडे पसरलेले आहे. मुळापासून शेंड्यापर्यंत पाणी जाते, मधें जागोजागी तें प्रगट होते. तसेंच जागोजागीं तें गुप्त राहाते.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this these great waters have expanded. Still in the beginning and in the end and in the middle also, where it appears in every place as this soft objectification, there is in every place, that hidden atma purush, the Knower.

owis.original: जे जे बीजीं मिश्रित जालें । तो तो स्वाद घेऊन उठिलें । उसानधें गोडीस आलें । परम सुंदर ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या प्रकारच्या बीजाशी पाण्याचें मिश्रण होते, त्या बीजाचा स्वाद पाण्यांत उतरतो. उसामध्यें पाण्याला सुदंर माधुर्य येते.
owis.englishMeaning: When these waters mix with this seed of mula maya, then that mula purush gets up and goes out and accepts these flavours (ie. then that purush becomes a man and he says, "I like this and this is good and this bad" etc.). Then in the sugarcane, that beautiful Supreme has become sweet and desirable (the purush is the real Knower of all these different tastes. He does not say, "Good or bad." But if He forgets Himself then, He becomes a man and distinquishes between the `many' different tastes)

owis.original: उदकाचें बांधा हें शरीर । उदक चि पाहिजे तदनंतर । उदकचि उत्पत्तिविस्तार । किती म्हणोनी सांगावा ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपले शरीर पाण्यापासूनच बांधलें जाते. मग बांधल्यानंतरही त्याला पाणी लागतेच. पाण्यापासून किती गोष्टी उत्पन्न होतात  याचा सर्व विस्तार सांगणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When that thoughtless Self and this `all' have become this imagined body built of these waters then, afterwards these waters are always required (ie. objectification requires constant objectification to maintain it; if not then objectification would cease and the imagined body would not remain). The creation and its continuous expansion are due to these waters and therefore the `many' thoughts should become thoughtless.

owis.original: उदक तारक उदक मारक । उदक नाना सौख्यदायेक । पाहातां उदकाचा विवेक । अलोलीक आहे ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पाणी जसें तारक आहे तसेंच मारकही आहे. पाणी माणसाला अनेक प्रकारचे सुख देते. विचार केला तर पाणी मोठे अलौकिक आहे असें दिसेल.
owis.englishMeaning: This water gives life to a jiva and this water takes that life away. This water is the giver of `many' pleasures and when you understand the vivek of this water then, there is this `wondrous all' (ie. when you understand and stop objectifying).

owis.original: भूमंडळीं धांवे नीर । नाना ध्वनी त्या सुंदर । धबाबां धबांबा थोर । रिचवतीधारा ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जमीनीवर जें पाणी वाहाते त्याचा आवाज मोठा सुंदर असतो. पाण्याच्या धारांचा धबाबा धबाबा असा आवाज मनाला मोठा आनंद देतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When this water element runs through the world then, there are the `many' sounds that have all come from this beautiful knowledge. Then that greatest brahman appears as the continuous noise of running water and the huge din it creates as it falls chaotically downwards.

owis.original: ठाईं ठाईं डोहो तुंबती । विशाळ तळीं डबाबिती । चबाबिती थबाबिती । कालवे पाट ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ठिकठिकाणीं डोह तुंबतात. प्रचंड जलाशय पाण्यानें तुडुंब भरलेले असतात. कालवे व पाण्याचे पाट पाण्यानें थबतहबलेले व चबचबलेले असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Where this water gets amassed at every place then, it is deep and huge and there is the sound of the low tone aum. But when it gets directed through `many' canals (ie. limiting concepts), then there is a dripping sound heard only.

owis.original: येकीं पालथ्या गंगा वाहाती । उदकें सन्निधचि असती । खळाळां झरे वाहाती । भूमीचे पोटीं ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कांहीं ठिकाणीं पालथ्या गंगा वाहतात. त्यांचे पाणी जमिनीच्या खाली पण जवळच असते. कित्येक ठिकाणीं जमिनीच्या पोटांत झरे खळाळत वाहात असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Still within that one jiva there is this ganga of knowledge flowing in the *opposite direction (maharaj- everyone is going to the east and the Master takes you to the west, where knowledge sets). And when this water of knowledge is understood then, that great One is felt to be very close. But if these waters roar downwards then, they become a trickle and finally disappear into the belly of this earth that is made up of gross inanimate objects. *(maharaj- Knowledge comes to you, this you don't understand)

owis.original: भूमीगर्भी डोहो भरले । कोण्ही देखिले ना ऐकिले । ठाईं ठाईं झोवीरे जाले । विदुल्यतांचे ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कोणी कधी पाहिलेले नाही व ऐकलेले नाहींत असे पाण्याचे डोह पृथ्वीच्या पोटांत भरलेले आहेत. कांहीं ठिकाणीं वीज पडून मोठा खड्डा पडतो. व त्यांतून वाहणारे झरे आढळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: In the womb of this earth element these waters overflow if one does not watch and listen to this aum. Then in every place these waters spring up due to the flashes of the mind (ie. in the dark clouds of ignorance, the mind flashes and reveals an object and it says, "What is this and what is that?" and objectification continues on its downward course)

owis.original: पृथ्वीतळीं पाणी भरलें । पृथ्वीमधें पाणी खेळे । पृथ्वीवरी प्रगटलें । उदंड पाणी ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा रीतीनें पृथ्वीच्या खाली पाणी भरलेले आहे. पृथ्वीच्या पोटांत पाणी खेळते. आणि पृथ्वीतलावर देखील पाणी सपाटून भरले आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: From below this earth these waters have overflowed. And in this earth these waters play ("I am so and so" etc.) and then, on this earth, that vast paramatma manifests as running water (then the jiva sees `many' forms).

owis.original: स्वर्गमृत्यपाताळीं । येक नदी तीन ताळीं । मेघोदक अंतराळीं । वृष्टी करी ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वर्ग, मृत्यु आणि पाताळ या तिन्ही लोकांत एकच गंगा नदी वाहते. तसेंच आकाशांतून मेघ वृष्टी करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One and this river of knowledge flow through the three worlds then, there is heaven, this world of death and hell. And then that One makes the showers of rain water to fall from the clouds of ignorance (then there are the `many' actions and God judges you ie. the law of karma, and you are caught is a shower of thoughts)

owis.original: पृथ्वीचे मूळ जीवन । जीवनाचें मूळ दहन । दहनाचें मूळ पवन । थोराहून थोर ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीचे मूळ आहे पाणी. पाण्याचे मूळ आहे अग्नि. अग्नीचें मूळ आहे वायु. हा वायु थोराहून थोर आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The root of this earth is these waters and the root of this water is the fire element. The wind element is the root of the fire and on account of this wind, there is space (ie. atma).

owis.original: त्याहून थोर परमेश्र्वर । महद्भूतांचा विचार । त्याहून थोर परात्पर । परब्रह्म जाणावें ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायुहून थोर आहे परमेश्र्वर म्हणजे अंतरात्मा. अंतरात्मा म्हणजे सर्व भूतांमधील श्रेष्ठ भूत होय. परब्रह्म हें त्याहून थोर व श्रेष्ठांमधील श्रेष्ठ जाणावें.
owis.englishMeaning: Greater than that atma (ie. antar-atma) is parameshwara (beyond ish- wara/antar-atma). He has no thought of that great element space and greater than that parameshwar is `the beyond the beyond'/paratpara and that should be known as parabrahman (and He has nothing to do and never did have anything to do with all this) Note: This great elemental water is the beginning of form, and therefore the birthplace of all living beings. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Agni Nirupan (A Discourse on the Fire Element)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: धन्य धन्य हा वैश्वानर । होये रघुनाथाचा श्वशुर । विश्वव्यापक विश्वंभरु । पिता जानकीचा ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा वैश्वानर अग्नि धन्य आहे. तो रामाचा सासरा आहे. सीतेनें अग्निदिव्य केले तेव्हां तो प्रकट होऊन म्हणाला, " रामा ही माझी कन्या अत्यंत पवित्र आहे. म्हणून तो सीतेचा पिता आहे. वैश्र्वानर विश्र्व व्यापतो. विश्र्वाचे पोषण करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed is this fire when thoughtlessness is understood; then it is janaka, the father- in-law of ram (ram is the son-in-law of janaka and He is a videhi- without a body). That Lord of creation (ie. janaka) pervades the whole creation, for He is the father of sita. (Fire is knowingness and knowingness is created from ram and sita, purush/prakruti)

owis.original: ज्याच्या मुखें भगवंत भोक्ता । जो ऋषीचा फळदाता । तमहिमरोगहर्ता । भर्ता विश्वजनाचा ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्निच्या मुखानें सर्व देवांना यज्ञामधील हविर्भाग पोचतो. ऋषींच्या तपश्चर्येला अग्नी फळ देतो. अंधार, थंडी व रोग यांचे तो निवारण करतो. तो सर्व जीवांना पोसतो व सांभाळतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When God enjoys all the offerings that are made through this mouth of that purush then, that purush is the giver of the desired fruit to the rishi (ie. due to this fire of knowingness, that God, the witnessing purush, accepts everything we offer to Him ie. He comes to know. The rishi's desire is for thoughtlessness). This fire is the protector and it is the remover of the ignorance of objectification. Cold (this ignorance) and this disease of the people (body consciousness) are removed by this fire. (The fire/knowingness is the means by which we offer all kinds of things to the purush/God. And when thoughtless is understood then, knowledge goes off and that purush is paramatma).

owis.original: नाना वर्ण नाना भेद । जीवमात्रास अभेद । अभेद आणी परम शुध । ब्रह्मादिकासी ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्राण्यांमध्ये वर्ण व भेद पुष्कळ आहेत. पण अग्नि सर्वांना म्हणजे ब्रह्मादिकांनाही अभेदानें असतो. तसाच तो सर्वांना अत्यंत शुद्ध असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There may be `many' different types and `many' different divisions but to every jiva this fire is the same. When there is this fire then, lord brahma, vishnu and mahesh (ie. the three gunas) are indivisible and then that supremely pure can be understood. (The earth and water elements create `many' divisions. Fire/knowingness does not cause `many' divisions in creation; only something is there outside of yourself)

owis.original: अग्नीकरितां सृष्टी चाले । अग्निकरिता लोक धाले । अग्नीकरितां सकळ ज्याले । लाहानथोर ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्नीमुळेंच सृष्टी चालते, लोक तृप्त होतात. सर्व लहानमोठे प्राणी अग्नीमुळेंच जिवंत राहतात.
owis.englishMeaning: It is due to this great fire element that the gross world can function; it is due to this fire that the world gets satisfaction ("Ah! I know") and it is due to this fire that there is this `all' and that great brahman within the small jiva (just like all the great elements, this fire plays two roles. This fire is the knowing of something other than myself and so is the beginning of separate forms. And this fire/knowing burns these separations when we stop objectifying and so leads us back to this `all' where there is only myself and finally to brahman, where I do not exist)

owis.original: अग्नीनें आळलें भूमंडळ । लोकांस राहाव्या जालें स्थळ । दीप दीपिका नाना ज्वाळ । जेथें तेथें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्नीमुळें पाणी आटून पृथ्वी तयार झाली. प्राणीमात्रांना रहावयास जागा झाली. अग्नीमुळें दिवे, पणत्या, अनेक प्रकारचे जाळ जिकडेतिकडे आढळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When this great fire brings with it this objectification of the gross world then, this gross world becomes the place for us to stay (knowingness is then the source of the "I am a body" concept). Then there are the `many' big and small flames everywhere (within each large or small jiva there is this flame burning). (Due to knowingness there is a world; for due to knowingness, that which is not is created)

owis.original: पोटामधें जठराग्नी । तेणें क्षुधा लागे जनीं । अग्नीकरितां भोजनीं । रुची येते ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पोटांत जठराग्नी असतो. त्यामुळें माणसांना भूक लागते. अग्नीमुळें अन्नाला चव येते.
owis.englishMeaning: In the belly, there is the fire of the belly (ie. the belly wants to know something) and then the people experience hunger; due to this fire there is the delight of the five senses (the senses want to know something).

owis.original: अग्नी सर्वांग व्यापक । उष्णें राहे कोणी येक । उष्ण नस्तां सकळ लोक । मरोन जाती ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसाच्या अंगभर अग्नि व्यापून राहतो. त्याच्या उष्णतेनें सर्व प्राणी जिवंत राहतात. अंगामधील उष्णता नाहींशी झाली तर सर्व प्राणी मरुन जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: This fire/knowingness within this `all' body is that which pervades this gross body and it is due to its heat that the One within everyone stays in this world. Without this heat of knowingness and this world of the `all' that One will die. *(First there is this effortless knowing of the `all' and when you look out, even slightly, then something appears on account of this fire element. There is something other than myself now. If this knowing becomes more objective then this water element and earth element ie. gross body and objectivity, get formed. In this way that One eternal atma takes birth and then dies due to ignorance ie. when knowingness goes off)

owis.original: आधीं अग्नी मंद होतो । पुढें प्राणी तो नासतो । ऐसा हा अनुभव येतो । प्राणीमात्रासी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रथम देहामधील अग्नी मंद होतो. नंतर प्राण्याची प्रकृति बिघडते. असा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव सगळ्यांना येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: At the beginning of time, when this fire was unmanifest, that atma had appeared as this `all' and afterwards when this fire manifested in the prana, that atma is as if not there (within mula maya all the elements are there as a potential and then when the gunas become manifest and mix together bringing objectivity, this knowingness appears). Then thoughtlessness and this experience `I am' appear in the prana only (then body consciousness appears and thoughtlessness and this `I am' are drowned in `many' thoughts).

owis.original: असतां अग्नीचें बळ । शत्रु जिंके तात्काळ । अग्नी आहे तावत्काळ । जिणे आहे ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्नीचें म्हणजे युद्धसामग्रससचे बळ असेल तर शत्रूला तत्काळ जिंकता येते. जोपर्यंत उष्णता असते, तोपर्यंत जिवंतपणा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the power of this fire then, the enemy (ie. ego) is conquered at that time. And as long as there is this knowingness, this body has life.

owis.original: नाना रस निर्माण जाले । अग्नीकरितां निपजले । माहांरोगी आरोग्य जाले । निमिषमात्रें ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत अनेक निरनिराळे रस निर्माण झालेले आहेत. ते सगळे अग्नीपासून उत्पन्न झाले आहेत.अग्नीमुळें महारोगीसुद्धा ताबडतोप बरें होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' tastes have been created due to this fire and this worst disease is also cured as soon as there is this fire (fire brings the understanding that, I am not gross).

owis.original: सूर्य सकळांहून विशेष । सूर्याउपरी अग्नीप्रकाश । रात्रभागीं लोक अग्नीस । साहें करिती ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूर्य सर्वांहून विशेष आहे, यांत वाद नाहीं. पण सूर्य मावळल्यावर अग्नीच प्रकाश देतो. रात्रीच्यावेळीं लोक अग्नीचीच मदत घेतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The Sun (ie. no knowledge) is greater than this `all' (knowledge) and afterwards that becomes this *light of the fire (for it knows the world). The sufferings of this world of darkness/ignorance are endured because of this fire. *(siddharameshwar maharaj- light means to know)

owis.original: अंत्यजगृहींचा अग्नी आणिला । त्यास दोष नाहीं बोलिला । सकळां गृहीं पवित्र जाला । वैश्र्वानर ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शूद्राच्या घरचा अग्नी आणला तरी चालतो. त्याला दोष नाहीं असें शास्त्रकार सांगतात. सर्व घरांतील अग्नी सारखाच पवित्र आहे असें समजावे.
owis.englishMeaning: If this fire/knowingness is brought from the house of the low caste (ie. gross body consciousness) then, this `speech' will not become impure (ie. objects are not created). And then, when this fire has purified this house, this `all' appears (this fire rids your mind of the thoughts that create this house you occupy/body consciousness).

owis.original: अग्नीहोत्र नाना याग । अग्नीकरितां होती सांग । अग्नी तृप्त होतां मग । सुप्रसन्न होतो ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्निहोत्र व अनेक यज्ञयाग अग्नीमुळे यथासांग होतात. अग्नि तृप्त झाला कीं मग तो अति प्रसन्न होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The real fire sacrifice is when the `many' concepts are offered in this fire and this rite can only be *properly performed if there is this knowingness. And when this fire has been satisfied then, there is pure joy (there is the ananda of this `I am'). *(siddharameshwar maharaj- an action can only said to have been done if it is done by mind, if has been done by body only it has not been done)

owis.original: देव दानव मानव । अग्नीकरितां चाले सर्व । सकळ जनासी उपाव । अग्नी आहे ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव, दानव आणि मानव या सर्वांचे व्यवहार अग्नीच्या बळावर चालतात. सर्व लोकांना अग्नि हाच तारक उपाय आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The gods, the demons and man (ie. the three worlds) function as this `all' on account of this fire. And by the remedy of this fire, the people become this `all'.

owis.original: लग्नें करिती थोर थोर । नाना दारुचा प्रकार । भूमंडळीं यात्रा थोर । दारुनें शोभती ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रीमंत लोक लग्नसमारंभ करतात, त्यांत शोभेच्या दारुचा वापर करतात.. जगांत मोठमोठ्या यात्रा भरतात. त्यांत दारुकामाचा शोभेसाठी वापर करतात. पण हा सगळा अग्नीचाच खेळ असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But when that `greatest of the great' engages Itself in worldly concerns then, there are the `many' forms of intoxicants (ie. attractions). Then in this world that `greatest' makes an empty, worthless journey that only appears beautiful due to these intoxi- cants.

owis.original: नाना लोक रोगी होती । उष्ण औषधें सेविती । तेणें लोक आरोग्य होती । वन्हीकरितां ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: बर्‍याच लोकांना रोग होतात. त्यासाठी ते उष्ण औषधेम घेतात त्यामुळें त्यांना बरें वाटते. त्यांना आरोग्य लाभते. हा परिणाम अखेर अग्नीचाच असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: But when that One who was infected by the diseases of this world of `many' thoughts, tastes of this `hot' remedy of fire then, His world becomes healthy again.

owis.original: ब्राह्मणास तनुमनु । सूर्यदेव हुताशनु । येतद्विषईं अनुमानु । कांहींच नाहीं ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सूर्य व अग्नि हेंच ब्राह्मनांचे सर्वस्व होय. ही गोष्ट प्रत्यक्ष आहे. याबद्दल कल्पना करण्याचे कारण नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: For then there is that Sun when this fire and the body and the mind are offered to that brahmin (ie. Knower of brahman). Then conjecture and even this `thing' no longer remain.

owis.original: लोकामध्यें जठरानळु । सागरीं आहे वडवानळु । भूगोळाबाहेर आवर्णानळु । शिवनेत्रीं विदुल्यता ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोकांच्या अंगांत जठरानल असतो. सागरामध्यें वडवानल असतो. भूगोलाबाहेर आवरणानल असतो. आणि शंकराच्या डोळ्यांत वीजरुपी अनल असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In the world, there is the fire in the stomach (ie. we spend our whole lives trying to satisfy this only and the tongue makes `many' differences ie. sweet, bad etc.). In the ocean there is this fire (therefore fire is more powerful than water) and beyond this world there is the controlling covering of fire (the fire pervades and is the controller of the waters and the waters are pervading and controlling the earth) and in the third eye of Lord shiva there is this `lightning' (ie. the vision of understanding `nothing is true').

owis.original: कुपीपासून अग्नी होतो । उंचदर्पणीं अग्नी निघतो । काष्ठमंथनी प्रगटतो । चकमकेनें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: काचेंतून अग्नी निघतो तसा तो उंच आरशांतून प्रगट होतो. लाकडावर लाकूड घासल्यानें व चकमकीनें अग्नि प्रगट होतो.
owis.englishMeaning: From anger this fire appears (anger is required to leave this world maharaj- be angry with the world, why do you keep me from myself?). In the *magnifying glass there is this fire and by rubbing of two wooden sticks or using a flint, this fire also appears (this fire is present within all objects and all objects appear in this knowing; maharaj- everything is knowledge; this chair is knowledge). *(When the sun rays are focused and not scattered here and there, then there is fire/knowing.)

owis.original: अग्नी सकळां ठाईं आहे । कठीण घिंसणीं प्रगट होये । आग्यासर्पें दग्ध होये । गिरीकंदरें ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्नि सर्व ठिकाणीं आहे. जोराच्या घर्षणानें तो प्रगट होतो. आग्यासापाच्या तोंडामधील अग्नि डोंगरदर्‍या जाळून टाकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Fire is this place of the `all' but when a hard substance is rubbed* then, this fire is produced. And then due to the burning bites of the snakes of desires, this knowingness brings objectification and that One residing within the heart is destroyed. *(When this `all' knows nothing other than itself, this is knowledge. But when something other than myself is known ie. a hardness is felt and some friction is there and there is the fire of knowingness)

owis.original: अग्नीकरितां नाना उपाये । अग्नीकरितां नाना अपाय । विवेकेंविण सकळ होये । निरार्थक ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्नीनें अनेक उपाय होतात. तसेंच अनेक अपायही होतात. विवेक केल्यावांचून हें सारें व्यर्थ जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of this great fire, there are the `many' remedies and on account of this fire there are the `many' harmful things. And without this vivek of knowingness, this `all' becomes the meaningless and empty `many'.

owis.original: भूमंडळीं लाहानथोर । सकळांस वन्हीचा आधार । अग्नीमुखें परमेश्र्वर । संतुष्ट होये ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांतील सगळ्या लहानथोरांना एका अग्नीचा आधार आहे. अग्नीच्या मुखानें परमेश्र्वर संतोष पावतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In this gross world there is that great atma (no knowledge) within the small jiva and there is this fire, the support of this `all' (knowledge of this `all' and this knowingness are inextricably linked). parameshwara (ie. the `great') gets satisfied when everything is offered through the mouth of this fire (see V.13).

owis.original: ऐसा अग्नीचा महिमा । बोलिजे तितुकी उणी उपमा । उत्तरोत्तर अगाध महिमा । अग्नीपुरुषाचा ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्नीचा महिमा असा आहे. अग्नीचा महिमा वर्णन करण्यास कोणतीही उपमा कमी पडते. अग्निपुरुषाचा महिमा विचार करतां अधिकच वाढत जातो.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is the greatness of fire and when this knowingness becomes this `spe- ech'/knowledge then, any simile falls short of describing it (ie. nothing is there). Then gradually that unfathomable Reality can be realized, for such is the greatness of this fire with that purush (that hidden purush accompanies every element. Without Him there can be nothing).

owis.original: जीत असतां सुखी करी । मेल्यां प्रेत भस्म करी । सर्वभक्षकु त्याची थोरी । काये म्हणोनी सांगावी ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणूस जिवंत असतांना अग्नि त्यास सुख देतो. तसेच तो मेल्यावर त्यास भस्म करतो. अग्नि सर्वभक्षक आहे. त्याचा मोठेपणा सांगावा तितका थोडाच आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Fire gives comfort and happiness when one is alive and fire turns the dead body to ashes (either literally or by vivek). And when this fire becomes thoughtless and devours this `all' then, how can its importance ever be described?

owis.original: सकळ सृष्टीचा संव्हार । प्रळय करी वैश्र्वानर । वैश्र्वानरें पदार्थमात्र । कांहींच उरेना ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रलयकाळीं अग्नि सर्व सृष्टीचा सांहार करतो. प्रलयाकालच्या अग्नीमुळें पदार्थ म्हणून कांहीं शिल्लक उरत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This `all' is the destruction of the gross creation and the fire is the one who burns it. For due to this fire, the objects do not remain and there is this `thing'.

owis.original: नाना होम उदंड करिती । घरोघरीं वैश्र्वदेव चालती । नाना क्षेत्रीं दीप जळती । देवापासीं ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्नीच्या योगानें अनेक होम करतात. घरोघरीं वैश्र्वदेव करतात. निरनिराळ्या क्षेत्रांमध्यें अग्निमुळें देवापाशी दिवे जळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: It is that paramatma who is the making the `many' fire sacrifices and in every house, that paramatma is present as this fire with that purush (in everybody there is knowing and this is the real fire sacrifice). And if that paramatma keeps this flame within the `many' bodies burning then, one stays near God/purush.
