(Forget everything and see the world with this knowingness and when there is the feeling `I am knowing' then, God, the purush is felt to be near by ie. when there is this knowingness then, there must be someone who is knowing. When this knowingness goes off, there is just effortless knowing and then this goes off there is that paramatma)

owis.original: दीपाराधनें निलांजनें । देव वोवाळिजे जनें । खरें खोटें निवडणें । दिव्य होतां ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: दीपाराधनें आणि निरांजनें अग्नीनें पेटवून लोक देवास ओवाळतात. अग्निदिव्य करुन लोक खरें खोटे निवडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: If a flame is waved around an idol then, the *people make that true God utterly useless. You can only become divine if you determine who the true God is and who He is not. *(Knowingness is the greatness of this great fire element. It is not the ritual of waving a flame before an idol. Such practice makes God stay so very far away).

owis.original: अष्टधा प्रकृती लोक तिन्ही । सकळ व्यापून राहिला वन्ही । अगाध महिमा वदनीं । किती म्हणोनी बोलावा ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तीन लोक व अष्टधा प्रकृति यांस अग्नीनें व्यापलें आहे. त्याचा महिमा तोंडानें सांगता येणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This eightfold prakruti is within these three worlds and as long as this `all' is per- vading these three worlds then, it stays as this fire/knowingness. Therefore the `many' should understand this `I am' and openly declare the greatness of that unfathomable swarup. (As long as the three worlds remain then, this fire of knowingness becomes the thought, "I am knowing so many things". But when everything is completely forgotten then, there is this wind of knowledge and the three worlds disappear)

owis.original: च्यारी श्रृंगें त्रिपदीं जात । दोनी शिरें सप्त हात । ऐसा बोलिला शास्त्रार्थ । प्रचितीविण ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अग्नीचें रुप वर्णन करतांना त्यास चार शिंगें, तीन पाय, दोन डोकीं आणि सात हात आहेत, असें शास्त्र सांगतें. मग ते प्रचितीनेंच सांगतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Fire is said to have four horns, three legs, two heads and seven arms. But this is merely a description given in the shasthras and it cannot bring this `I am' experience.

owis.original: ऐसा वन्ही उष्णमूर्ती । तो मी बोलिलों येथामती । न्यून्यपूर्ण क्षमा श्रोतीं । केलें पाहिजे ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: उष्णमूर्ति अग्नि असा आहे. माझ्या बुद्धीप्रमाणें मी त्याचे वर्णन केलें. जें कमीजास्त झालें असेल त्याबद्दल श्रोत्यांनी क्षमा करावी.
owis.englishMeaning: But when this fire becomes this whole creation formed of knowledge then, there is this `speech' and such is as much as `I' can understand (this `speech' is still within the mind). In this way, this defective (and imagined) earth should be made whole within the good listener (ie. this `all'). .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Vayo Stavan Nirupan (A Discourse in Praise of the Wind)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: धन्य धन्य हा वायदेव । याचा विचित्र स्वभाव । वायोकरितां सकळ जीव । वर्तती जनीं ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा वायुदेव धन्य होय. याचा स्वभाव मोठा विलक्षण आहे. या वायुच्यामुळें जगांत सर्व प्राणी वर्तन करतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Blessed is this wind that is with that God/purush. The nature of this wind is this marvellous wonder of the `all' (knowledge). And it is on account of this wind of the `all' that there is a jiva existing in this world (ie. knowledge is the base of everything. Therefore forget everything).

owis.original: वायोकरितां श्र्वासोश्र्वास । नाना विद्यांचा अभ्यास । वायोकरितां शरीरास । चळण घडे ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायुच्या योगानें श्वासोश्र्वास चालतो. अनेक विद्यांचा अभ्यास याच्यामुळें करता येतो. वायुमुळें शरीराचे चलनवलन करतां येते.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this wind there is breathing* in and breathing out and the study of the `many' knowledges (ie. this body that you take as yourself appears within this `all' body of the wind. This breathing happens naturally, you cannot stop it but still you feel, "I am breathing." But this body is breathing and you know this breathing just as you know everything else and therefore you are separate from all this). And due to this wind, this `all' body is made to move (still you are separate from this moving `all'). *(maharaj- when you wake up first there is space and when there is space, knowledge is there and then the breathe comes)

owis.original: चळण वळण प्रासारण । निरोधन आणी आकोचन । प्राण अपान व्यान उदान । समान वायु ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चलन, वलन, प्रसारण, आणि आकुंचन या गोष्टी वायु घडवून आणतो. प्राण, अपान, व्यान, उदान व समान अशा पांच प्रकारानें तो माणसाच्या शरीरांत वावरतो. हे पांच मुख्य प्राण आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this wind there is the moving, turning, expanding, resisting and the con- tracting of this gross body. Then there are the vital winds of prana, apana, vyana, udana and samana (see 17.8.11).

owis.original: नाग कूर्म कर्कश वायो । देवदत्त धनंजयो । ऐसे हे वायोचे स्वभावो । उदंड असती ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाग, कुर्म, कृकल, देवदत्त व धनंजय हे पांच उपप्राण आहेत. अशा रीतीनें वायु विभागून शरीर चालवितो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there are the naga, korma and krukala, along with the devadatta and dhana- njaya (ie. minor vital winds in body). When these appear then that thoughtless vast paramatma is of the nature of the wind.

owis.original: वायो ब्रह्मांडीं प्रगटला । ब्रह्मांडदेवतांस पुरवला । तेथुनी पिंडीं प्रगटला । नाना गुणें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायु प्रथम ब्रह्मांडामधें प्रगट झाला. त्यानें अनेक ब्रह्मांडदेवता निर्माण केल्या. मग तो अनेक प्रकारांनीं पिंडांत प्रगट झाला.
owis.englishMeaning: This wind/knowledge has manifested in the universe/brahmanda, yet still it pervades this brahmanda and its gunas (ie. the universe was created/appeared by the three gunas or objectification). And this wind that came from `there' has manifested as the pinda due to these `many' gunas (the wind was born of brahman and it contains the unmanifest gunas and when they become manifest then there is the brahmanda and an individual body).

owis.original: स्वर्गलोकीं सकळ देव । तैसेचि पुरुषार्थी दानव । मृत्यलोकींचें मानव । विख्यात राजे ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्वर्गलोकांतील सर्व देव, तसेच मोठे [राक्रमी राक्षस, मृत्युलोकांतील विख्यात मानव राजे,
owis.englishMeaning: Just as this `all'/prakruti and that God/atma purush are present within heaven (ie. dream, sattwa) so too, both are present within the powerful demon of ignorance (ie. sleep, tama, for you know you have slept). And the man in this world of death (ie. waking, raja) is also due to that great King (atma purush). (Within the three states of waking, dream and sleep there is this prakruti/wind and purush)

owis.original: नरदेहीं नाना भेदे । अनंत भेदाची श्वापदें । वनचरें जळचरें आनंदें । क्रिडा करिती ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्याचप्रमाणें अनेक प्रकारचे भेद असलेले नरदेह, अनेक प्रकारचे भेद असलेली श्वापदे, वनचरें, जळचरें, आनंदानें क्रिडा करणारे हे प्राणी,
owis.englishMeaning: That atma is within the `many' different human bodies and it is that endless atma that plays blissfully through the different wild and domestic creatures and the creatures of the water.

owis.original: त्या समस्तांमधें वायु खेळे । खेचरकुळ अवघें चळे । उठती वन्हीचे उबाळे । वायोकरितां ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या सगळ्यांमध्यें वायु खेळतो. आकाशांत राहणारे पक्षी वायुमुळे उडूं शकतात. आगीचे लोळ वायुमुळें उठतात.
owis.englishMeaning: This wind is playing in this whole creation but is not recognized by the `many' people due to the `many' things. And it is on account of this wind, that the flames of the fire (knowingness) rise higher and higher (this effortless knowledge is the support of your knowingness).

owis.original: वायो मेघाचे भरण भरी । सवेंच पिटून परतें सारी । वायो ऐसा कारबारी । दुसरा नाहीं ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायु प्रथम आकाशांत खूप मेघ भरतो. मग लगेच त्यांना दूर लोटतो. म्हणून वायुसारखा कारभार करणारा दुसरा कोणी नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: It is this wind which makes the clouds of *ignorance gather and it is this wind which blows these clouds away also. This wind and no other is the director of everything. *(This wind is mula maya)

owis.original: परी ते आत्मयाची सत्ता । वर्ते शरीरीं तत्वता । परी व्यापकपणें या समर्था । तुळण नाहीं ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या वायुला अंतरात्म्याची सत्ता पाठीशी आहे. ती सत्ताच वायुच्यारुपानें शरीरांत काम करतअसते. पण व्यापकपणाच्या दृष्टीनें पाहिलें तर या समर्थ वायुची तुलना दुसर्‍या कोणाशी होऊं शकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: But, in truth, this power of existence is with that atma, for within this wind that atma exists. Still this power of the wind, due to its pervasiveness, cannot be compared to anything other (ie. this wind/prakruti along with the support of that atma is the creator of everything).

owis.original: गिरीहून दाट फौजा । मेघ उठिले लोककाजा । गर्जगर्जो तडक विजा । वायोबळें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पर्वतांच्यामाथ्यावर ढगांचे सैन्य लोकांच्या कल्याणासाठीं वायुच जमवतो. मोठमोठ्या विजा चमकतात आणि मग पाऊस पडतो. हे सगळें वायुच्या बळानेंच होते.
owis.englishMeaning: It is the wind that commands this cloud of ignorance, that appears as solid as a mountain, to arise and then there comes the needs of the world (ie. this wind of maya brings ignorance and the concept `I am' and then there comes the concepts and desires that appear so big and so real to the people of this world). Then due to the power of this wind, there are the loud crashes of thunder ("I am so and so", the ego roars) and the `many' flashes of lightening (and mind flashes in the darkness says, "This is there and that is there").

owis.original: चंद्र सूर्य नक्षत्रमाळा । ग्रहमंडळें मेघमाळा । ये ब्रह्मांडीं नाना कळा । वायोकरितां ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चंद्र, सूर्य, नक्षत्रमाला, ग्रहमंडळ, मेघमाला, इत्यादि ज्या उत्तम गोष्टी या चिश्र्वांत आधळतात, त्या वायुमुळेंच घडून आल्या आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: Then there is the whole star system, the sun, the moon and the planets as well as the ranges of clouds. These `many' forms have appeared within the universe/brahmanda on account of this art of the wind (when the mind flashes and reveals objects and starts naming them, then that which was undivided and just known, appears as separate objects and there is the moon, a star system, different kinds of cloud; previously before the arising of this individual mind there was the universal mind of the wind ie. `all' and no things were there).

owis.original: येकवटलें तें निवडेना । कालवलें तें वेगळें होयेना । तैसें हे बेंचाड नाना । केवी कळे ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायूच्या बळानेंच पंचभूतें एके ठिकाणी येऊन एकमेकांत मिसळली. ती आतां वेगळीं करतां येत नाहीत. पंचभूतांचा हा गुंतडा सहज उकलणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When jumbled together as the `many' objects, that Reality cannot be determined. When mixed together into the `many' forms, that Reality cannot be separated out. But just as the `many' cannot know that thoughtless Self, what can that thoughtless know of this dense cluster of the `many' thoughts? (When there are the `many' thoughts, the thoughtless cannot be understood and when there is that thoughtless is understood then, there cannot be a world created by the `many' thoughts)

owis.original: वायो सुटे सरारां । असंभाव्य पडती गारा । तैसे जीव हे नीरा- । सरिसे पडती ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मोठा सोसाट्याचा वारा सुटला कीं गारांची प्रचंड वृष्टी होते. त्या पाण्याबरोबर पुष्कळ जीव पृथ्वीवर पडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: When this wind is unrestrained it makes a lot of loud noise and then that unattaina- ble Self, tumbles down and becomes the `many' gross forms. And when this wind settles and becomes still then, that fallen down jiva becomes like that thoughtless paramatma.

owis.original: वायुरुपें कमळकळा । तोचि आधार जळा । तया जळाच्या आधारें भूगोळा । शेषें धरिलें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या सूक्ष्म कमळामध्यें ब्रह्मदेव राहतो, तो कमलकोष वायुरुपच आहे. पाण्याला त्याचाच आधार आहे. पाण्याच्या आधारानें शेषानें डोक्यावर भूगोळ धरला आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to this wind-form there is lakshmi's art (`I am') and then her support, narayan, becomes the waters of objectification (narayan forgets Himself and becomes a servant of His maya). Then shesh (ie. narayan) with the support of these waters has to hold this burden of the gross earth on one of His heads (shesh, who is the purush, complete in Himself and who needs no support has then been divided up and seeks the support this world of `many' thoughts).

owis.original: शेषास पवनाचा आहार । आहारें फुगे शरीर । तरी मग घेतला भार । भूमंडळाचा ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वायु हा शेषाचा आहार आहे. त्या वायुनें त्याचे शरीर फुगते. त्यामुळें भूगोलाचे वजन त्याला सहन करता येते.
owis.englishMeaning: When shesh needs this wind for His nourishment then, this `all' body swells up with pride and declares `I am brahman'. And then afterwards He has to endure the burden of this world (and the ego of body consciousness). (He who is completely independent seeks the support of this `I am' and when that is forgotten, He seeks the support of a gross body)

owis.original: माहांकूर्माचें शरीर भलें । नेणों ब्रह्मांड पालथें घातलें । येवढें शरीर तें राहिलें । वायोचेनी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: महाकूर्माचे शरीर इतके प्रचंड, येवढें मोठे होतें कीं, त्याचें वरचे कवच पाहून जणूं काय ब्रह्मांड पालथें घातलें आहे असें वाटते. येवढे मोठें त्याचे शरीर वायुमुळेंच टिकतें.
owis.englishMeaning: But when the wise thoroughly search through this `all' body of the *great tortoise then, the whole brahmanda is not known. But at that time, due to this wind of mula maya, that Reality has to exist as this huge `all' body (ie. those with vivek attain this knowledge and then the gross universe returns to where it came from. *(In the scriptures it is said that, the great tortoise is one of the ten incarnations of vishnu and he is capable of carrying this whole creation/brahmanda on his back. An incarnation or avatar is considered holy by the people, but maharaj described it as a coming down of that Reality. It means knowledge and upon this knowledge the whole world has appeared. Thus vishnu is said to be the support of this whole world. From the ignorant's point of view, acquisition of this knowledge is a great thing but from the gnyani's point of view, it is not)

owis.original: वाराहें आपुलें दंतीं । पृथ्वी धरिली होती । तयाची येवढी शक्ती । वायुबळें ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वराह अवतारामधें वराहानें आपल्या दातांवर पृथ्वी धरली. वायुमुळेंच येवढी शक्ती त्यास लाभली.
owis.englishMeaning: The *great boar is said to be another of these incarnations of vishnu and he had held this earth on just one of his large teeth. This incarnation of knowledge and this gross world have all been created by the wind element and it is the power/shakti of that Reality (this power/wind is so great that this `all' and the gross existence is contained within it; yet this understanding keeps that Reality concealed). *(In this wind of mula maya there is knowing/knowledge, the `light of the world'/existence, the three gunas and five elements unmanifest and that hidden purush)

owis.original: ब्रह्मा विष्णु महेश्र्वर । चौथा आपण जगदेश्र्वर । वायोस्वरुप विचार । विवेकी जाणती ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, महेश आणि चौथा जगदीश्र्वर अंतरात्मा हे सारे वायुस्वरुपीं  आहेत. असें विचार करुन विवेकीं पुरुष जाणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the three gods or gunas, brahma, vishnu and maheshwar. And there is the fourth guna, that pure sattwa, and through this, you become the Lord of the world. For the viveki knows that this wind is with that swarup (ie. prakruti/purush) and He becomes thoughtless. (The three gunas bring body consciousness. When these are dropped, there is this knowledge and the hidden purush. And when this is dropped, there is that thoughtless Reality that was previously hidden within all this maya)

owis.original: तेतिस कोटी सुरवर । अठ्यासी सहस्त्र ऋषेश्र्वर । सिध योगी भारेंभार । वायोकरितां ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तेहतीस कोटी देव, अठ्याऐंशी हजार ऋषी, सिद्ध व योगी यांचे मोठे समुदाय, या सर्वांना वायुमुळेंच बळ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: It is due to this wind that there are three hundred and thirty *koti gods.11 It is due to the wind there are the `many' forms made up of the eighty-four principles of the jiva, the four forms of birth and that Lord of the rishi. And due to this wind there are the powerful siddhas and yogis. *(koti means the pure sattwa guna of effortless knowing and thoughtlessness is the Lord or purush. The numbers are a play on the principles of creation eg. due to the wind there are thirty-three ie. twenty-five principles of the subtle body and five elements and the three gunas, plus that pure sattwa guna)

owis.original: नव कोटी कात्यायणी । छेपन कोटी च्यामुंडिणी । औट कोटी भूतखाणी । वायोरुपे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नऊ कोटी कात्यायनी, छप्पन कोटी चामुंडा साडेतीन कोटी भूतें ही सगळीं वायुरुपच आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: It is due to this wind that there are the katyayani (ie. killings and beatings) made up of five elements and the four sources of birth and that pure sattwa. Due to this wind, there are the chamundini (ie. a show or pretence by those covered in skin) made up of the fifty-six and that pure sattwa. For due to this wind that is represented by this symbol aum, there are the three gunas and that pure sattwa guna and from these the great elements appeared and afterwards a world of `many' forms.

owis.original: भूतें देवतें नाना शक्ती । वायोरुप त्यांच्या वेक्ती । नाना जीव नेणो किती । भूमंडळीं ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: भुतें, दैवतें, ानेक प्रकारच्या शक्ती ही सर्व वायुरुपच घेऊन प्रगट होतात. अशा प्रकारचें वायुरुप जीव या भूमंडळांत कितेेआहेत तें सांगतां येणार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to these elements and the three gods/gunas, there are these `many' powers. These have all manifested from this wind form and this wind is the manifestation of that paramatma. But that paramatma knows nothing of the `many' jiva in this world (That paramatma uses this power/knowledge to create and from this knowledge the `many' worlds appear).

owis.original: पिंडीं ब्रह्मांडीं पूरवला । बाहेर कंचुकास गेला । सकळां ठाईं पुरवला । समर्थ वायु ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंडांत व न्रह्मांडांत वायु आहेच. पण बाहेर कंचुकापर्यंत देखील त्याचा व्याप आहे. अशा रीतीनें सर्वांना पुरुन उरणारा वायु मोठा सामर्थ्यवान आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: In the pinda and in the brahmanda, this wind and that purush pervade when these outer coverings are destroyed (the earth element, water element and fire element that are the cause of objectification). For whenever there is this place of the `all' then, there is that purush and this wind (then there is this wind element and that hidden space or purush).

owis.original: ऐसा हा समर्थ पवन । हनुमंत जयाचा नंदन । रघुनाथस्मर्णीं तनमन । हनुमंताचें ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अशा या समर्थ वायुचा मुलगा हनुमंत होय. श्रीरामाच्या स्मरणामधें त्याचे तन व मन अखंड गुंतलेलें होते.
owis.englishMeaning: Like this is that thoughtless Self and this wind (purush/prakruti). *hanumanta is called the son of this wind, his mind and body was always absorbed in the remembrance of Lord ram. *(siddharameshwar maharaj- hanu means to kill/surrender and mana is the mind)

owis.original: हनुमंत वायोचा प्रसीध । पित्यापुत्रांस नाहीं भेद । म्हणोनि दोघेहि अभेद । पुरुषार्थविषीं ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हनुमंत वायुचाच आहे ही गोष्ट प्रसिद्ध आहे. बापलेकामधें मुळींच भेद नाही. म्हणून दोघांच्या पराक्रमांतहि मुळींच भेद नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: hanumanta is the manifestation of this wind but there is in truth, no difference between his father (the wind) and his son (the prana) and therefore they are equal as regards their power.

owis.original: हनुमंतास बोलिजे प्राणनाथ । येणें गुणें हा समर्थ । प्राणेंविण सकळ वेर्थ । होत जातें ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हनुमंताला प्राणनाथ म्हणतात. यावरुन त्याचे सामर्थ्य काय ते लक्षांत येईल. एक प्राण नसेल तर सर्व व्यर्थ होऊन जाते.
owis.englishMeaning: And when on account of this pure sattwa guna, that thoughtless swarup is un- derstood then, hanumanta should be called the lord of the prana (ie. the Knower of the breath). But when the breath/prana is not remembered then this `all' becomes an empty and useless thing (ie. that thoughtless swarup is beyond the prana and this wind also. You are the lord of the prana when everything is forgotten and your prana merges in the wind. For when the mind has been killed or surrendered then, names and forms do not arise and what is perceived is a world without name and form and the limiting concept, "I am a body". This is knowledge or the `all' or the wind. Then `here' there is a constant awareness of the rising and falling of this breath within knowledge and due to the ten vital winds (see V. 4, 5) there is the functioning of the body but, as the limiting concept of "I am a body" is gone, this breathing and these actions of the body are not considered as any different from this whole moving action of knowledge. In this way, inside and outside does not remain, the pinda merges in the brahmanda, or the prana merges with the wind, or the jivatma becomes shivatma. Otherwise due to the `many' thoughts, there is the "I am a body" concept, a pinda, no awareness of this ever present breath, an inside and outside and then this `all' world is as if not there).

owis.original: मागें मृत्य आला हनुमंता । तेव्हां वायो रोधला होता । सकळ देवांस आवस्ता । प्राणांत मांडलें ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मागें एकदां हनुमंताचा मृत्यु प्रसंग ओढवला असतां वायुनें सर्वांचे प्राण आकर्षून घेतले, यामुळें सर्व देव घाबरले त्यांच्यापुढें मृत्यु उभा राहीला.
owis.englishMeaning: Previously hanumanta had died and so the wind was obstructed (ie. his mind was not surrendered and so this wind was confined to a body and there was body consciousness). For at that time this `all' was placed in the *prana with the three gods/gunas and there was a mind full of `many' thoughts and concepts. But when he surrendered his mind then, this `all' state was understood. *(maharaj- the whole world is on riding on the breath)

owis.original: देव सकळ मिळोन । केलें वायूचें स्तवन । वायो प्रसन्न होऊन । मोकळें केलें ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मग सर्व देवांनीं एकत्र येऊन वायुची स्तुती केली. मग वायु प्रसन्न होऊन त्यानें सर्वांचा प्राण मोकळा केला.
owis.englishMeaning: Then the gods/gunas were merged into this `all' and the praises of this wind were sung. This delighted the wind, for it was freed from its confinement (ie. then the prana merges with the wind and the three gunas disappear and one is released from the confinement of body consciousness; then all concepts are cast out of the mind and one becomes so open). (siddharameshwar maharaj- the prana is the same as the wind outside and therefore within and outside belongs to you, or the prana inside and the wind outside belongs to God, but it cannot belong to both)

owis.original: म्हणोनी प्रतापी थोर । हनुमंत ईश्र्वरी अवतार । याचा पुरुषार्थ सुरवर । पाहातचि राहिले ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: म्हणुन मोठा प्रतापी असा हनुमान ईश्र्वरी अवतार आहे. याचा पराक्रम देव नुसता पाहातच राहिले.
owis.englishMeaning: Therefore hanumanta is the glory and power of this wind (they are truly, one and the same). Then the senses understand the power of this `speech' and this `all' remains (when you surrender your mind then, this `all' is understood and the senses are happy to stay with this `all').

owis.original: देव कारागृहीं होते । हनुमंते देखिलें अवचितें । संव्हार करुनी लंकेभोंवतें । विटंबून पाडिलें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळे देव रावणाच्या कैदेंत होते. हनुमंतानें एकाएकी त्यांना पाहिलें. त्यानें राक्षसांची विटंबना केली. त्यांना मारुन लंकेभोवती टाकून दिलें.
owis.englishMeaning: God had been jailed in the *prison (ie. body) of ravana (ie. ego). So hanumanta sear- ched for Him by surrendering his mind and suddenly he saw Him (when everything was forgotten, He was there). Seeing Him destroyed everything surrrounding lanka/body; and the gross was no longer enticing and body consciousness was defeated (hanumanta was dedicated to God ie. ram. By killing all his concepts, objectification, the naming of this and that, the seeing through the senses ceased and the prana merged in the wind. Then God was felt to be close by). *(God has been confined to the body/lanka, by ravana/the ego with the 10 heads/senses.)

owis.original: उसिणें घेतलें देवांचें । मूळ शोधिलें राक्षसांचें । मोठे कौतुक पुछ्याकेताचें । आश्र्चीर्य वाटे ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देवांना कैदेंत टाकले त्याचा बदला मारुतीनें घेतला. राक्षसांची पाळेंमुळें खणून काढली. पुच्छकेतु मारुतीचे कौतुक पाहून मोठे आश्र्चर्य वाटलें.
owis.englishMeaning: To avenge God's imprisonment hanumanta had searched out the origin of that demon (ie. ignorance). When there was this surrender by the monkey then, hanumanta understood this great wonder of the `all'. (maharaj- the monkey is the mind)

owis.original: रावण होता सिंह्यासनावरी । तेथें जाऊन ठोसरें मारी । लंकेमधें निरोध करी । उदक कैचें ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रावण सिंहासनावर बसला होता. मारुतीनें तेथें जाऊन त्याला ठोसे मारले. लंकेमधें निरोध केला. तेथें पाणी मिळेनासे झालें.
owis.englishMeaning: ravana had been sitting on the throne. Therefore hanumanta (ie. the surrendered mind) went `there' to ram, and knocked this *ego off the throne. When the ego is destroyed then, how can one be imprisoned by these waters of objectification within this gross body of lanka? *(It is this ego "I am a body" that wants to objectify)

owis.original: देवास आधार वाटला । मोठा पुरुषार्थ देखिला । मनामधें रघुनाथाला । करुणा करिती ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मारुतीचा मोठा पराक्रम पाहून देवांना मोठा आधार वाटला. देवांनी मनानें श्रीरामाची करुणा भाकली.
owis.englishMeaning: When one feels that God is their support then, this power of ram is understood and so in the mind there is much love for ram.

owis.original: दैत्य आवघे संव्हारिले । देव तत्काळ सोडिले । प्राणीमात्र सुखी जाले । त्रयलोक्यवासी ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सगळे दैत्य मारुन टाकले. देवांना ताबडतोप मोकळें केलें. तिन्ही लोकांतील प्राणीमात्रांस अशाप्रकारें सुखी केलें.
owis.englishMeaning: When the demon ignorance and the `many' things are destroyed then, at that time, God is released and the one in only the prana is that One who resides within the three worlds and so there is great happiness. Note: hanumanta searched out God by surrendering his mind and then he understood that the prana within and the wind outside were one and the same (ie. body cons- ciousness became universal consciousness). When the thoughts cease then the prana merges with the wind and the limiting concept of being a body simply does not remain at that time. .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Mahadbhoot Nirupan (A Discourse on the Great Elements)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: पृथ्वीचें मूळ जीवन । जीवनाचें मूळ अग्न । अग्नीचें मूळ पवन । मागां निरोपिलें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीचे मूळ पाणी, पाण्याचे मूळ अग्नि, अग्निचे मूळ वायु हे मागें सांगून झालें.
owis.englishMeaning: This water element is the origin of the earth element; the root of the water is the fire; and the root of fire is the wind; these were the previous discourses.

owis.original: आतां ऐका पवनाचे मूळ । तो हा अंतरात्माचि केवळ । अत्यंतचि चंचळ । सकळांमधें ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आतां वायुचे मूळ ऐका. अंतरात्मा हा वायुचे मूळ आहे. सर्व सगुणांमधें तो चंचळ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Now listen to the root of the wind. That pure knowledge has become this antar-atma and then it is extremely active within this `all'.

owis.original: तो येतो जातो दिसेना । स्थिर होऊन बैसेना । ज्याचें रुप अनुमानेना । वेदश्रुतीसी ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा येतो व जातो, पण तो दिसत नाहीं. तो कधीं स्थिर होऊन बसत नाहीं. वेदश्रुतींना त्याच्या रुपाची कल्पना करतां येत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that antar-atma comes and goes but It cannot be seen and It never remains still (though It is within this `all' and cannot be seen still, It assumes this `all' form and gets seen and then It comes and goes). But this form of that purush is not the conjecture read in the vedas and it has to be experienced (word knowledge is not enough. For there has been no change in the mind. maharaj- you should feel, `Oh, a change has come in me')

owis.original: मुळीं मुळींचें स्फुर्ण । तेंचि अंतरात्म्याचें लक्षण । जगदेश्र्वरापासून त्रिगुण । पुढें जाले ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूळ परब्रह्मामध्यें अगदी पहिलें जे स्फुरण झाले तेंच अंतरात्म्याचे लक्षण होय. तोच जगदीश्वर असून त्याच्यापासून पुढें तीन गुण झालें.
owis.englishMeaning: When at the root there is this original `I am' then, that Reality has become this attention of the antar-atma (when there is this `I am' then, it is the antar-atma who is knowing it and the triad of Knower, known and knowing is formed). Afterwards from this Lord of the world, the three gunas appeared.

owis.original: त्रिगुणापासून जालीं भूतें । पावलीं पष्ट दशेतें । त्या भूतांचें स्वरुप तें । विवेकें वोळखावें ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तीन गुणांपासून पंचभूतें झाली. आणि पुढें त्यांना व्यक्तदशा आली. पंचभूतांचें व्यक्त किंवा अव्यक्त स्वरुप विवेकानें ओळखावें.
owis.englishMeaning: From these three gunas, the great elements have come and then they became ap- parent to the *ten senses. How that swarup has become these great elements should be recognized by vivek. *(When each great element mixed with the others and became gross)

owis.original: त्यामधें मुख्य आकाश । चौ भूतांमधें विशेष । याच्या प्रकाशें प्रकाश । सकळ कांहीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पंचभूतांमध्यें आकाश मुख्य आहे. बाकीच्या चार भूतामपेक्षां आकाश कांहीं तरी विशेष आहे. त्याच्या प्रकाशानें इतर सर्व कांहीं प्रकाशते.
owis.englishMeaning: Within these elements there is that Supreme and this space element. And within the other four elements there is this pure sattwa (ie. wind). Then due to His light there is the lustre of this `all thing'.

owis.original: येक विष्णु महद्भूत । ऐसा भूतांचा संकेत । परंतु याची प्रचीत । पाहिली पाहिजे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व भूतांमध्यें एक विष्णु हें महद्भूत आहे, अशी सर्व भूतांची खूण आहे. परंतु याचा अर्थ काय आहे तें स्वानुभवानें पाहिलें पाहीजे.
owis.englishMeaning: There is that One, there is vishnu (knowing) and there is that great element called space and so in this way, that One has been assigned as an element. But this experience of this `I am' should be clearly understood (this will not really be understood until you give up all your thoughts and gain this `experience'. Then one will understand that without the Knower, this `I am' could not shine. He is called space but space is not something that can be known like this `object' or the other elements/bhuta. bhuta means, that has appeared, but in truth, space cannot be that)

owis.original: विस्तारें बोलिलीं भूतें । त्या भूतामधें व्यापक तें । विवरोन पाहातां येते । प्रत्ययासी ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पूर्वीं पंचभूतांचें विस्तारानें वर्णन केलें. त्याच्यामधें कोणतें मूळतत्व व्यापून आहे, ते विवरुन पाहावें. म्हणजे अंतरात्म्याचा प्रत्यय येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: It is due to the expansion of that One, that there is this `speech' along with this space element and therefore that pervader within the other elements (ie. space) is that Reality. But it is only through deep investigation that you can come to understand that this space is nirgun.

owis.original: आत्मयाच्या चपळपणापुढें । वायो तें किती बापुडें । आत्म्याचे चपळपण रोकडें । समजोन पाहावें ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा अत्यंत सूक्ष्म व चंपळ आहे. गतिमान आहे. त्याच्या तुलनेनें वायुचे चपळपण कमी पडते. अंतरात्म्याचे चपलपण प्रत्यक्ष अनुभवानें समजून घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is the swiftness of that atma then, That has become this wind and then after, That is the confused `many'. But the swiftness of the atma can only be understood when this ever present experience has been understood by you.

owis.original: आत्म्यावेगळें काम चालेना । आत्मा दिसेना ना आडळेना । गुप्तरुपें विचार नाना । पाहोन सोडी ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्म्याशिवाय कोणतेही कार्य घडत नाहीं. पण अमतरात्मा कोठें दिसत नाही. तो स्वतः गुप्त राहून अनेक प्रकारचे विचार करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: No action can ever be taken without the atma and yet that atma is not visible nor can it be grasped by the senses. The `many' thoughts will become that thoughtless atma when this `all' is understood and then let slip.

owis.original: पिंड ब्रह्मांड व्यापून धरिलें । नाना शरीरीं विळासलें । विवेकी जनासी भासलें । जगदांतरीं ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पिंडांत तसेंच ब्रह्मांडांत तो व्यापून राहिला आहे. अनेक प्रकारच्या देहांत त्याचा विलास आढळतो. आत्मानात्मविवेकी पुरुषांना तो जगाच्या अंतर्यामी अनुभवास येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma is pervading and upholding the pinda and the brahmanda and within this `all', that atma plays as the `many' forms. Only the viveki understands Him who is within this inner space (known) and who has appeared as the mind (that atma is everything; the Knower, the known and the `many' forms).

owis.original: आत्म्याविण देहे चालती । हें तों न घडे कल्पांतीं । अष्टधा प्रकृतींच्या वेक्ती । रुपासी आल्या ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्म्याशिवाय देह चालणें कधींच शक्य नाहीं. अष्टधा प्रकृतीमधें असणारे अव्यक्त घटक म्हणजें पंचभूतें आणि तीन गुण. त्यांना अंतरात्म्यामुळें व्यक्त रुप प्राप्त होते.
owis.englishMeaning: If you think that the body can move without the atma then, that thoughtless paramatma at the `end of imagination' will never be accomplished. It is that atma who has brought this manifestation of the eight-fold prakruti.

owis.original: मुळापासून सेवटवरी । सकळ कांहीं आत्माच करी । आत्म्यापैलीकडे निर्विकारी । परब्रह्म तें ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अगदी मूळापासून तें थेट अखेरपर्यंत जें जें कांहीं होत जाते तें तें सर्व कांहीं अंतरात्माच घडवून आणतो. या अंतरात्म्याच्या पलीकडे निर्विकार असें परब्रह्म आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: From beginning to the end, when there is this `all thing' then, the atma is the `doer' (ie. antaratma); and beyond this atma within that unmodified brahman, there is that parabrahman (that antaratma has forgotten Itself and assumed this form. This he appears as maya within brahman. parabrahman has nothing to do with all this)

owis.original: आत्मा शरीरीं वर्ततो । इंद्रियेंग्राम चेष्टवितो । नाना सुखदुःखें भोगितो । देह्यात्मयोगें ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा देहांत राहतो. तोच सर्व इंद्रियांना चेतना देतो. देहाशी संबंध आल्यानें अनेक प्रकारची सुखदुःखे तो भोगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma stays within this `all' body and He arouses the assembled sense organs. Then there are the `many' sufferings of pain and enjoyments of pleasure due to the association of the gross body and that atma.

owis.original: सप्तकंचुक हें ब्रह्मांड । त्यामधें सप्तकंचुक पिंड । त्या पिंडामधें आत्मा जाड । विवेकें वोळखा ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ब्रह्मांड सप्तकंचुकानें वेढलेलें आहे. तसेंच पिंडदेखील सप्तकंचुकानें वेढलेला आहे. पिंडामधें असणारा अतिसूक्ष्म अंतरात्मा विवेकानें ओळखावा.
owis.englishMeaning: That thoughtless atma is the brahmanda with its seven coverings and within the brahmanda, It is the pinda with its seven coverings. In the pinda it is the atma that is true and He should be recognized by vivek.

owis.original: शब्द ऐकोन समजतो । समजोन प्रत्योत्तर देतो । कठीण मृद सीतोष्ण जाणतो । त्वचेमधें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: शब्द ऐकला कीं, आत्म्यास त्याचा अर्थ समजतो. अर्थ समजून तो त्याचे उत्तर देतो. त्वचेच्या द्वारा आत्मा मऊ, कठिण, थंड, गरम जाणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: It is that atma who listens to and understands this `word' `I am' and having under- stood it, that atma replies with this `word'. It is that atma who knows by the skin, the hard, soft, cool and hot.

owis.original: नेत्रीं भरोनी पदार्थ पाहाणें । नाना पदार्थ परीक्षणें । उंच नीच समजणें । मनामधें ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: डोळ्यांत भरुन आत्मा पदार्थ पाहातो. अनेक वस्तूंची परीक्षा करतो. भारी आणी हलकी मनानें समजतो.
owis.englishMeaning: By seeing, the eyes are filled with `many' objects and by proper examination the `many' objects become this `object'. Still this `object' is that highest and constant Self being understood in the mind (ie. still it is maya).

owis.original: क्रूरदृष्टी सौम्यदृष्टी । कपटदृष्टी कृपादृष्टी । नाना प्रकारींच्या दृष्टी । भेद जाणे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: क्रूर, सौम्य, कपट, कृपा असे नानाप्रकारचे दृष्टीभेद आत्माच जाणतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The cruel frown, the soft glance, the cunning stare and the look of benevolence; it is He who knows these `many' different kinds of looks

owis.original: जिव्हेमधें नाना स्वाद । निवडूं जाणे भेदाभेद । जें जें जाणें तें तें विशद । करुनी बोले ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जिभेनें तो अनेक प्रकारचे स्वाद ओळखतो, आणि त्यांच्यामधील भेद व अभेद दोन्ही जाणतो. त्याचप्रमाणें इतर जें जें जाणतो तें तें स्पष्ट करुन सांगतो.
owis.englishMeaning: In the tongue there are the `many' tastes and it is that atma that determines them and knows the differences. And even when mula maya is knowing, still it is that atma who is making this `speech'.

owis.original: उत्तम अन्नाचे परिमळ । नाना सुगंध परिमळ । नाना फळांचे परिमळ । घ्राणइंद्रियें जाणे ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नाकाने तोच आत्मा उत्तम अन्नाचें सुगंध जाणतो. त्याचप्रमाणें इतर सुगंध  व फळांचे सुगंध तो नाकानें ओळखतो.
owis.englishMeaning: Then that thoughtless purush and this *fragrance of the `all'/prakruti are the `many' good smells and then the aroma of the `many' fruits are known through the nose. *(ie. the fragrance that remains when the gross objects are removed; just like the fragrance of the flower that remains even after the flower has been taken away)

owis.original: जिव्हेने स्वाद घेणें बोलणें । पाणीइंद्रियें घेणें देणें । पादइंद्रियें येणें जाणें । सर्वकाळ ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जिभेनें स्वाद घेणें व बोलणें, हातांनी देणें व घेणें, पायांनी नेहमी येणें व जाणें,
owis.englishMeaning: The tongue accepts the taste due to this `speech'. By the hands, He takes and gives and by feet, He comes and goes; and all this takes place within this `time of the all'. (Knowledge is the base of the gross existence and through knowledge that atma experiences)

owis.original: शिस्नइंद्रियें सुरतभोग । गुदइंद्रियें मळोत्सर्ग । मनेंकरुनी सकळ सांग । कल्पून पाहे ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जननेद्रियांनें कामसुख भोगणें, गुदानें मलोत्सर्ग करणें, मनानें सर्व सांगकल्पना करुन पाहणें,
owis.englishMeaning: It is He who enjoys sex through the penis; it is He who drops excreta with the anus; and through the mind, He understands this `all' perfectly and also imagines the `many' things.

owis.original: ऐेसे व्यापार परोपरी । त्रिभुवनीं येकलाचि करी । त्याची वर्णावया थोरी । दुसरा नाहीं ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: असें नानाप्रकारचे व्यापार त्रिभुवनामध्यें हा एकटा अंतरात्माच करतो. त्याचा महिमा वर्णन करण्यास त्याच्यासारखा दुसरा कोणीच नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Such is His pervasiveness in the many different forms. He alone is the only `doer' in the three worlds. The greatness of that atma cannot be declared by this `all' even.

owis.original: त्याविण दुसरा कैचा । जे महिमा सांगावा तयाचा । व्याप आटोप आत्मयाचा । न भूतो न भविष्यति ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्याचा महिमा सांगता येईल असा अंतरात्म्याखेरीज जगांत दुसरा कोणी नाही. अंतरात्म्याचा विस्तार व त्याची कार्यशक्ति आजपर्यंत कधीं झाली नाही आणि पुढें कधी होणार नाहीं, अशी अद्वितीय आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Without that atma how can there be this `other/all'? Therefore this mula maya should understand thoughtlessness, for this is the greatness of that atma. This expanse and the capacity of that atma is not in the past or the future (but there is still a `now').

owis.original: चौदा विद्या चौसष्टी कळा । धूर्तपणाच्या नाना कळा । वेद शास्त्र पुराण जिव्हाळा । तेणेंविण कैचा ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: चौदा विद्या, चौसष्ट कला, चतुरपणाच्या अनेक कला, वेदशास्त्रपुराणें यांचे रहस्य, या सर्व गोष्टी अंतरात्म्यामुळें होऊं शकतात.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the fourteen types of learnings and the sixty-four arts. It is due to His intelligence and alertness that these `many' arts become this `art' of knowing and wi- thout that Reality, how could there be this `speech' which is the source of the vedas, shasthras and puranas?

owis.original: येहलोकींचा आचार । परलोकीं सारासार विचार । उभय लोकींचा निर्धार । आत्माच करी ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या जगांतील आचार, परमार्थांतील सारासार विचार, प्रपंच व परमार्थ दोन्हीचें निश्र्चित ज्ञान, अंतरात्माच करुन देतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this proper conduct (ie. `all') within the gross world and that thoughtless essence within this world beyond. The support within both these worlds is given by the atma only.

owis.original: नाना मतें नाना भेद । नाना संवाद वेवाद । नाना निश्र्चय भेदाभेद । आत्माच करी ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अनेक प्रकारची मतें, त्यांच्यामधील अनेक प्रकारचे भेद, नाना प्रकारचे वाद, आणि संवाद, नाना प्रकारचे निश्र्चित निर्णय, आणि अनेक प्रकारचे भेदाभेद हे सर्व आत्माच करतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There are the `many' opinions and the `many' differences; there is that pure dialogue and the `many' arguments and there are the `many' different convictions made by that atma.

owis.original: मुख्य तत्व विस्तारलें । तेणें तयास रुप आणिलें । येणेंकरितां सार्थक जालें । सकळ कांहीं ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या सबंध चंचळ विश्वाचे मुख्य तत्व अंतरात्मा होय. त्या एकट्याचा विस्तार झाला. त्यामुळें त्याची अनेक व्यक्त रुपें झाली. यामुळें या सार्‍या दृश्य विश्वाला एक प्रकारचे सार्थकपण आले.
owis.englishMeaning: That Supreme (pure knowledge) had expanded and on account of this form (`all') everything was brought back to that Reality. And on account of thoughtlessness, this `all thing' accomplished the meaning of life (ie. that Reality is achieved).

owis.original: लिहिणें वाचणें पाठांतर करणें । पुसणें सांगणें अर्थ करणें । गाणें वाजवणें नाचणें । आत्म्याचकरितां ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लिहिणें, वाचणें, पाठांतर करणें, विचारणें, सांगणें, अर्थ करणें, गाणें, बजावणें, नृत्य करणें या सगळ्या गोष्टी आत्म्याचे प्रेरणेनें घडतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the atma alone, *`writing' and `reading' is learned by heart. Due to the atma there is the wiping out of this `writing' and then there is that thoughtless meaning. And due to the atma there is singing and playing of `many' instruments and dancing. *(From one point of knowledge the `story' is written and witnessed)

owis.original: नाना सुखें आनंदतो । नाना दुःखें कष्टी होतो । देहे धरितो आणी सोडितो । नाना प्रकारें ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा अंतरात्मा सुखानें आनंदून जातो. तर दुःखानें कष्टी होतो. तो अनेक प्रकारे देह धरतो आणि देह सोडतो.
owis.englishMeaning: The `many' pleasures make that atma happy; the `many' sufferings makes that atma unhappy; that atma holds the physical bodies and then leaves them in `many' various ways.

owis.original: येकलाचि नाना देहे धरी । येकलाचि नटे परोपरी । नट नाट्यकळा कुसरी । त्याविण नाहीं ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा एकच एक अंतरात्मा अनेक देह धारण करतो. एकटाच तो नानापरीनें नटतो. नटाचें सोंग, नाट्य, आणि अभिनयाचे चातुर्य सारें अंतरात्म्याच्या योगानें चालते.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma alone is the holder of the `many' bodies. That atma alone takes the various parts and roles. Without that atma there is no actor, no drama, no art and no skill.

owis.original: येकलाचि जाला बहुरुपी । बहुरुपी बहुसाक्षपी । बहुरुपें बहुप्रतापी । आणी लंडी ॥ ३२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा हा एकटाच एक खरा, पण बहुरुप्याप्रमाणें अनेक सोंगे घेतो, तो बहुरुपी असून मोठ उद्योगी आहे. त्याचा पुष्कळ पराक्रम व रुपें आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma alone appears like the `many' forms and still within the `many' forms there is that very alert atma. But when there are the `many' forms then, that atma is the very powerful in the `many' and the very cowardly in the `many' also.

owis.original: येकलाचि विस्तारला कैसा । पाहे बहुविध तमासा । दंपत्येंविण कैसा । विस्तारला ॥ ३३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा हा एकच एक असतांना त्याचा येवढा विस्तार कसा झाला. हें एक आक्ष्चर्यच आहे. त्याचा देखावा नाना प्रकारचा आहे. दांपत्य नसून अंतरात्म्याचें  कुटुंब केवढे तरी विस्तारलें.
owis.englishMeaning: The mystery of how that atma alone has expanded into many forms is to be under- stood. One should understand how that atma spread so much without a male-female relationship.

owis.original: स्त्रियांस पाहिजे पुरुष । पुरुषासी पाहिजे स्त्रीवेष । ऐसा आवडीचा संतोष । परस्परें ॥ ३४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्रीला पुरुष हवासा वाटतो तर पुरुषाला स्त्री हवीशी वाटते. एकमेकांच्या परस्पर आवडीमधें एकमेकांना संतोष वाटतो.
owis.englishMeaning: prakruti needs her purush and that purush needs the guise of His prakruti and in this way, there is mutual satisfaction.

owis.original: स्थूळाचें मूळ तें लिंग । लिंगामधें हें प्रसंग । येणें प्रकारें जग । प्रत्यक्ष चाले ॥ ३५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्थूल देहाचे मूळ लिंगदेहामध्यें वावासनात्मक सूक्ष्मदेहामध्यें असतें. तेथील वासनेप्रमाणें पुरुष किंवा स्त्रीदेह प्राप्त होतो. याप्रमाणें जगप्रत्यक्ष चाललेलें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The root of the gross body is the mental body and in the mental body, there is this connection of prakruti/purush. And it is on account of this that there is the gross world experienced through the senses.

owis.original: पुरुषांचा जीव स्त्रियांची जीवी । ऐसी होती उठाठेवी । परी या सूक्ष्माची गोवी । समजली पाहिजे ॥ ३६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुरुषांचा तो जीव व स्त्रियांची ती जीवी, असें अज्ञानी लोक चुकीनें बोलतात. पण पुरुष किंवा स्त्रीदेह येणें हें सूक्ष्मदेजाच्या गुंतागुंतीवर अवलंबून असतें हें ध्यानांत ठेवावे.
owis.englishMeaning: When that purush is a man and this prakruti is a woman then, there is meddling and confusion. But this is an entanglement for that brahman and therefore this `speech' should be understood.

owis.original: स्थूळाकरितां वाटे भेद । सूक्ष्मीं आवघेंचि अभेद । ऐसें बोलणें निरुध । प्रत्यया आले ॥ ३७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्थूलामध्यें हा भेद दिसतो खरा, पण सूक्ष्मामधें असा भेद मुळींच नाहीं. तेथें सगळा अभेद आहे. हें बोलणें निश्र्चितपणें अनुभवास येणारें आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to the gross body, differences are felt but, in brahman, these `many' things become undifferentiated. It is the conviction of this `speech' that brings that nirgun understanding.

owis.original: बायकोनें बायकोस भोगिलें । ऐसें नाहीं कीं घडलें । बायकोस अंतरी लागलें । ध्यान पुरुषाचें ॥ ३८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्रीनें स्त्रीचा उपभोग घेतला असें कांहीं कधीं घडत नाहीं. स्त्रीला मनांत पुरुषाचे ध्यान लागतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Does a woman have sex with a woman? How can this ever happen? Just as a woman longs for her man, so too, in the inner space, prakruti is thinking of her purush.

owis.original: स्त्रीसी पुरुष पुरुषास वधु । ऐसा आहे हा संमधु । याकारणें सूक्ष्म संवादु । सुक्ष्मीं च आहे ॥ ३९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: स्त्रीला पुरुष आणि पुरुषाला स्त्री हवी, असा हा संबंध आहे. या कारणानें या संबंधाची सूक्ष्म प्रक्रिया सूक्ष्म देहांतच सापडते.
owis.englishMeaning: When for prakruti there is that purush and for the purush there is His woman then, thoughtlessness has become this relationship of prakruti/purush. But it is by means of this `speech', that brahman can have this dialogue within brahman only.

owis.original: पुरुषइछेमधें प्रकृती । प्रकृतीमधें पुरुषवेक्ती । प्रकृतीपुरुष बोलती । येणें न्यायें ॥ ४० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुरुषाच्या इच्छेमध्यें प्रकृतीची अभिव्यक्ती आणि प्रकृतीच्या विकासामधें पुरुषाची अभिव्यक्ती असा हा परस्पर संबंध आहे. या न्यायानेंच प्रकृतिपुरुष असें लोक म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: The `wish' in the purush is prakruti and in the prakruti that purush becomes manifest. In this way there is the `speech' of prakruti/purush (every morning we awake with this desire to just know and just be, but suddenly, due to habit, there is the desire to know `many' things).

owis.original: पिंडावरुन ब्रह्मांड पाहावें । प्रचीतीनें प्रचीतीस घ्यावें । उमजेना तरी उमजावें । विवराविवरों ॥ ४१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आपण पिंडरचनेवरुन ब्रह्मांडरचना समजून घ्यावी. पिंडाच्या बाबतींतील प्रचीतीवरुन ब्रह्मांडाच्या बाबतींत प्रचीति घ्यावी. हें ध्यानांत येत नसेल तर वारंवार विचारणा करुन समजून घ्यावें.
owis.englishMeaning: While in this pinda, this brahmanda will be understood if, this `experience' accepts this `experience' (this `I am' was always there but an acceptor was required. Then this pinda and brahmanda will disappear in zero/nothingness). By continuous careful investigation there should be understanding by not understanding (ie. forgetting is understanding).

owis.original: द्वैतइछा होते मुळीं । तरी ते आली भूमंडळीं । भूमंडळीं आणी मुळीं । रुजु पाहावें ॥ ४२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: द्वैतइच्छा अगदी मूळांत झाली, तेथून ती दृश्यांत पृथ्वीवर आली. येथील द्वैतइच्छा आणि अगदी मूळ द्वैतइच्छा या दोन्हींचा मेळ घालावा.
owis.englishMeaning: When at the root that One has this `wish' of duality then, that Reality comes into the world. That nirgun is within this world and within this root of mula maya too and that One should be understood.

owis.original: येथें मोठा जाला साक्षेप । फिटला श्रोत्यांचा आक्षेप । जे प्रकृतीपुरुषाचें रुप । निवडोन गेलें ॥ ४३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रकृति व पुरुष यांचें स्वरुप नीटपणें व स्पष्टपणें कळलें आणि श्रोत्यांच्या शंकांचे समाधान झालें. हें एक मोठेंच काम झालें. असें म्हणण्यास हरकत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When brahman appears `here' and has determined intent (ie. to know) then, the objections of the listener are cast away (ie. and there is only knowing and no questions arise). Therefore this form of prakruti/purush should be determined and thereafter left aside. Note: So this is the series of seven, this dashak's main title. That Reality, nirgun reali- zation, purush/space and prakruti/wind and the three other elements: 16.2. nirgun brahman, paramatma, parameshwara: I do not exist understanding, direct experience of no-otherness. But that is not eternally established as when the salt dis- solves in the ocean to never become salt again. 16.7. Space/purush is there as the background of this knowledge. He gives existence to prakruti. This space and wind are inseparable 16.6. Wind/prakruti is to just exist and just know; there is no inside or outside here 16.5. Fire: to know something else; an inside and outside is felt 16.4. Water: `soft' form is there 16.3. Earth: definite hard form has appeared .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Atmaram Nirupan (A Discourse on the Atmaram)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: नमूं गणपती मंगलमूर्ती । जयाचेनि मतिस्फूर्ती । लोक भजती स्तवन करिती । आत्मयाचें ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मंगळमूर्ती गणपतीला मी नमन करतो. याच्या सत्तेनें बुद्धिमधें स्फूर्ति निर्माण होते. या स्फूर्तीनें लोक आत्म्याचे भजन आणि स्तवन करितात.
owis.englishMeaning: With the understanding of this `I am', I bow down to ganapati, the embodiment of good fortune and *auspiciousness. The one who understands this `I am' is making bhajan and this is the praising of that atma (ganapati). *(siddharameshwar maharaj- when the knowledge of maya has been cast off, then it is auspicious)

owis.original: नमूं वैखरी वागेश्र्वरी । अभ्यांतरीं प्रकाश करी । नाना भरोवरी विवरी । नाना विद्या ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वाणींची स्वामीनी जी वैखरी तिला मी वंदन करतो. माणसाच्या अंतर्यामीं ती प्रकाश उत्पन्न करते. अनेक विद्यांची रहस्यें ती संपूर्णपणें स्पष्ट करुन देते.
owis.englishMeaning: I bow down to this speech of sharada which lights us from within. But because of her, there is the liking of the `many' different investigations and the `many' forms of learning.

owis.original: सकळ जनामधें नाम । रामनाम उत्तमोत्तम । श्रम जाउनी विश्राम । चंद्रमौळी पावला ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सर्व लोकांमधें रामनाम हें उत्तमोत्तम आहे. रामनाम घेतल्यानें श्रीशंकराचा शीण गेला.आणि त्यास विश्रांती मिळाली.
owis.englishMeaning: Yet within these `many' learnings there is this `I am' of sharada and this `name' of ram is the best of all learnings. By this `name', Lord shankara was relieved of the burning sensation in His throat caused by the taking of halahala poison and He became very peaceful (halahala is worldly difficulties. maharaj He kept in his throat and so didn't digest them).

owis.original: नामाचा महिमा थोर । रुप कैसें उत्तरोत्तर । परात्पर परमेश्र्वर । त्रयलोक्यधर्ता ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नामाचा महिमा फार थोर आहे. त्रैलोक्यधर्ता परमेश्र्वर आणि परात्पर म्हणजें श्रेष्ठांमध्यें श्रेष्ठ असणारें निर्गुण व निराकार परब्रह्म, असें भगवंताचें चढतेंवाढतें रुप नामास प्राप्त होते.
owis.englishMeaning: The greatness of this `name' is that through this, one becomes brahman and then, even this `I am' form does not remain? Then the upholder of these 3 worlds (ie. ishwara, antar-atma) becomes that parameshwar, the One beyond everything.

owis.original: आत्माराम चहुंकडे । लोक वावडे जिकडे तिकडे । देहे पडे मृत्य घडे । आत्मयाविण ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक आत्माराम अंतर्यामीरुपानें सर्वत्र व्यापून आहे. त्याच्या योगानें जगांत सगळीकडे लोकांचा व्यवहार चालतो. तो जेथें नसतो तेथें देह पडतो, मृत्यु घडून येतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That atmaram is everywhere yet the people wander about from here to there in search of Him. For they have taken this body as themselves and then they die without that knowledge of the atma.

owis.original: जीवात्मा शिवात्मा परमात्मा । जगदात्मा विश्र्वात्मा गुप्तात्मा । आत्मा अंतरात्मा सूक्ष्मात्मा । देवदानवमानवीं ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देव, दानव आणि मानव यांच्यामध्यें अंतरात्म्यास जीवात्मा, शिवात्मा, परमात्मा, जगदात्मा, विश्वात्मा, गुप्तात्मा, आत्मा, अंतरात्मा, सूक्ष्मात्मा अशी नावें आढळतात.
owis.englishMeaning: He is the jivatma, the shivatma and the paramatma (see 8.7.45- 52); He is the atma of the world, the atma of the creation, the hidden atma; He is the atma, antaratma and subtle-atma and He is within the three worlds.

owis.original: सकळ मार्ग चालती बोलती । अवतारपंगतीची गती । आत्म्याकरितां होत जाती । ब्रह्मादिक ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: या अंतरात्म्याच्या योगानें जगांतील सर्व मार्ग चालतात. सर्व प्रकारचे व्यवहार घडतात. नाना अवतारांचे कार्य त्याच्या योगानेंच घडून येते. त्या अंतरात्म्यामुळेंच ब्रह्मादिक देव होतात आणि जातात.
owis.englishMeaning: On account of that atma there is this way of the `all' and then, that One `moves' and that One `speaks' (`I am everything and I am everywhere'). In this state that atma has the companionship of knowledge and on account of that atma there are the comings and goings of lord brahma etc (that atma is ever there and account of it there is the waking ie. brahma, dream/vishnu and deep sleep/mahesh states).

owis.original: नादरुप जोतीरुप । साक्षरुप सत्तारुप । चैतन्यरुप सस्वरुप । द्रष्टारुप जाणिजे ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्म्याला आणखी कांहीं नावांनीं ओळखतात. तीं नांवें अशी नादरुप, ज्योतिरुप,साक्षीरुप, सत्तारुप, चैतन्यरुप, स्वस्वरुप, द्रष्टारुप,
owis.englishMeaning: On account of that atma there is this sound form (aum), this light form (to know); this witnessed form and this existence form (to be). That atma knows this chaitanya form as Its own form and that atma is the seer's form also.

owis.original: नरोत्तमु वीरोत्तमु । पुरुषोत्तमु रघोत्तमु । सर्वोत्तमु उत्तमोत्तमु । त्रयलोक्यवासी ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: नरोत्तम, वीरोत्तम, पुरुषोत्तम, रघूत्तम, सर्वोत्तम, उत्तमोत्तम आणि त्रैलोक्यवासी.
owis.englishMeaning: That dweller within the three worlds is superior among men and the bravest among the brave; He is the best purush and the best among the kings of the dynasty of ram; He is the best in the `all' and the most superior of the superior.

owis.original: नाना खटपट आणी चटपट । नाना लटपट आणि झटपट । आत्मा नस्तां सर्व सपाट । चहुंकडे ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत घडून येणार्‍या सार्‍या घटना, माणसांच्या हातून होणारी सारी कर्में, त्यांच्या जीवनांतील युक्त्या, प्रयुक्त्या आणि घाई व गर्दी या सर्वांचे कारण मूळ अंतरात्मा आहे. तो जर नसेल तर चहूकडे सगळी निष्प्राण होईल.
owis.englishMeaning: When there are the `many' toils and troubles and hankering and longings; the `many' agitations and altercations and hurries and confusions then, that atma is not and this `all' is destroyed in every direction.

owis.original: आत्म्याविण वेडें कुडें । आत्म्याविण मडें बापुडें । आत्म्याविण थडें रोकडें । शरीराचें ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा नसेल तर शरीरांत कांहीं अर्थ उरत नाहीं. तें वेडेवाकडें होऊन जाते. आत्म्याशिवाय तें मढें बनतें. आत्मा नसेल तर शरीराचे प्रत्यक्ष थडगे बनतें.
owis.englishMeaning: Without that atma there is falsity and madness; without the atma there is just a useless corpse; and without the atma, that ever-present `all' body becomes a mere carcass.

owis.original: आत्मज्ञानी समजे मनीं । पाहे जनीं आत्मयालागुनी । भुवनी अथवा त्रिभुवनीं । आत्म्याविणें वोस ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मज्ञानी पुरुष अंतरात्म्याचें हें कर्तृत्व मनांत निश्र्चितपणें जाणतो. त्यामुळें लोकांमध्यें सूक्ष्मपणानें कार्य करणार्‍या आत्म्याकडेच त्याची दृष्टी असते. पृथ्वीवर तसेंच त्रिभुवनांगतही अंतरात्म्यावाचून सगळे ओसाड पडतें. अंतरात्माच हा सगळीकडे जिवंतपणाचे, चैतन्याचें मूळ आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma gnyani/Knower understands this `all' in His mind and then in the people, He sees *Himself. In this gross world or in this `all' within these three worlds, there is nothing without the atma. *(When maharaj was asked why he took all this trouble at his age to travel to Europe and America, he said, "Because I see myself in trouble")

owis.original: परम सुंदर आणि चतुर । जाणे सकळ सारासार । आत्म्याविण अंधकार । उभय लोकीं ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: हा अंतरात्मा अतिसुंदर व चतुर आहे. तो सगळे सारासार जाणतो. तो ज्ञानमय असल्यानें, तो नसेल तर इहलोकीं व परलोकीं, प्रपंचांत व परमार्थांत सर्वत्र अज्ञान-अंधार भरतो.
owis.englishMeaning: That Supreme atma is beautiful and clever; It knows the `all' and It is the thou- ghtless. Without the atma there is darkness in the gross world and the world beyond.

owis.original: सर्वांगीं सिध सावध । नाना भेद नाना वेध । नाना खेद आणी आनंद । तेणेंचिकरितां ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: तो सर्वांगांनीं सिद्ध आहे. परिपूर्ण आहे. तो सदैव सावध असतो. सदैव तत्रपर असतो. अनेक प्रकारचे भेद, वेध, खेद, आणि आनंद अंतरात्म्याच्या योगानें होतात.
owis.englishMeaning: He is the alert siddha within this `all' body. And the `many' divisions, the `many' distinctions; the `many' worries, anxieties and concerns; the `many' pains and grief and the `many' pleasures and this bliss of `I am' are all on account of that atma only.

owis.original: रंक अथवा ब्रह्मादिक । येकचि चालवी अनेक । पाहावा नित्यानित्यविवेक । कोण्हीयेकें ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: रंक असो अथवा ब्रह्मादिक देव असोत, एक अंतरात्मा या सर्वांना चालवतो. माणसानें नित्यानित्यविवेक करावा म्हणजे हें आकलन होईल.
owis.englishMeaning: Whether there is a beggar or lord brahma etc., that One makes to move these numerous different forms. That One within everyone should be understood through the vivek that distinquishes between the indestructible and the destructible (atma is indestructible, all else is destructible).

owis.original: ज्याचे घरी पद्मिणी नारी । आत्मा तंवरी आवडी धरी । आत्मा गेलियां शरीरीं । तेज कैचें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समजा एखाद्याच्या घरांत पद्मिनी स्त्री आहे. पण तिच्या शरीरांत जोपर्यंत आत्मा असतो तोपर्यंत तिच्यावर प्रेम राहाते. आत्मा शरीर टाकून निघून गेला मग तेथें कांहीं तेजच उरत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: A husband is fond of his beautiful wife as long as that atma holds her up. When the atma leaves, how can there be the splendour and lustre that is born of this `all' body (the beauty of the gross body is on account of this beautiful `all' body)?13

owis.original: आत्मा दिसेना ना भासेना । बाह्याकारें अनुमानेना । नाना मनाच्या कल्पना । आत्मयाचेनी ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: आत्मा इंद्रियांना गोचर नाहीं. मनाच्या कक्षेंत तो येत नाहीं. कोणत्याही बाहेरील किंवा दृश्य व स्थूल साधनांनी त्याची कल्पना करतां येत नाहीं. आपल्या मनामध्यें ज्या नाना प्रकारच्या कल्पना निर्माण होतात त्या सर्व अंतरात्म्यामुळेंच असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: atma is not seen or felt and by the outer shape it cannot be surmised. But these `many' imaginings of the mind are on account of that atma.

owis.original: आत्मा शरीरीं वास्तव्य करी । अवघें ब्रह्मांड विवरी भरी । वासना भावना परोपरीं । किती म्हणोनी सांगाव्या ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा शरीरांत वास्तव्य करतो. तेथें तो सार्‍या ब्रह्मांडाचा विचार करतो. तो ब्रह्मांड भरुन राहतो. शरीरांत अनेक प्रकारच्या वासना करतो. भावना अनुभवतो. त्या सर्व सांगणें कठीण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: That atma resides within this `all' body when He fills the whole brahmanda with His investigation. But this vasana, to just be, has become the various different emotions and desires and therefore the `many' should become thoughtless. (This vasana simply wants to exist but when it becomes the `many' forms then `many' emotions etc. arise)

owis.original: मनाच्या अनंत वृत्ती । अनंत कल्पना धरिती । अनंत प्राणी सांगों किती । अंतर त्यांचें ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंतरात्मा शरीरांतर्यामी असतो तेव्हा मनांत अनंत वृत्ती येऊन जातात. अनंत कल्पनांचे तरंग उठतात. जगामध्यें अनंत प्राणी आहेत. त्यांच्या अंतरंगाचे संपूर्ण वर्णन करणें शक्य नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: It is that endless atma that is this knowing vritti of the mind and it is that endless atma that is the holder of concepts and imaginings. It is that endless atma that is thoughtless, the `many' in the prana and this inner space of that atma.

owis.original: अनंत राजकारणें धरणें । कुबुधी सुबुधी विवरणें । कळों नेदणें चुकावणें । प्राणीमात्रासी ॥ २० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: अंनत प्रकारचे राजकारण करणें म्हणजे अनंत प्रकारच्या खटपटी लटपटी करणें चांगली व वाईट बुद्धि यामधें फरक करणें. आपला बेत कोणास कळूं न देणें. कोणास चुकवणे या सार्‍या गोष्टी जीवप्राणी अंतरात्म्याच्या योगानें करुं शकतात.
owis.englishMeaning: It is that endless atma that holds firmly to raja-karana (ie. `He does everything') and it is that atma that thinks with a foolish buddhi and with a wise buddhi. And by not imparting Its nirgun understanding, that atma goes unrealized in the prana.

owis.original: येकास येक जपती टपती । येकास येक खपती लपती । शत्रुपणाची स्थिती गती । चहुंकडे ॥ २१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: एक एकास जपतो. एक एकास मारण्यास टपतो. एक एकास खपतो. एक एकापासून लपतो. एक एकाचे शत्रुत्व करतो. अशा रीतीनें चहुंकडून अंतरात्म्याची गति असते.
owis.englishMeaning: That One either cares for and patiently watches over the other (`Everywhere, I am there') or that is a jiva and then it conceals and disposes of that One and then everywhere there is the state of enduring enmity.

owis.original: पृथ्वीमधें परोपरीं । येकास येक सिंतरी । कित्येक भक्त परोपरीं । परोपकार करिती ॥ २२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत एक एकास सारखा फसवतो. पण त्याचबरोबर पुष्कळ भक्त सारखा परोपकार करतात. हें अंतरात्म्यामुळेंच घडतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When there is objectification then, there are the various different forms and the one jiva deceives and defeats that One atma. Either that One within the `many' is the `many' different devotees in their `many' forms or that One is that which uplifts this `all' (ie. sagun becomes nirgun atma).

owis.original: येक आत्मा अनंत भेद । देहेपरत्वें घेती स्वाद । आत्मा ठाईंचा अभेद । भेद हि धरी ॥ २३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मुळांत अंतरात्मा एकच एक आहे. पण देहपरत्वें अनंत भेद होतात. आणि प्रत्येक देहानुसार निरनिराळे भोग घेणें चालतें. याचा अर्थ असा कीं मूळ अंतरात्मा एकच एक असला, तरीही तो भेदानें पण राहूं शकतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that One is different to that endless atma then, by virtue of a gross body that accepts the various flavours and smells as Its own experiences. But the place of that atma is undivided and the divisions are due to the holding of the body.

owis.original: पुरुषास स्त्री पाहिजे । स्त्रीस पुरुष पाहिजे । नवरीस नवरी पाहिजे । हें तों घडेना ॥ २४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुरुषास स्त्री हवी असते. तर स्त्रीला पुरुष हवा असतो. नवरीला नवरी हवी असें कांहीं कधीं घडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: This prakruti wants that purush and that purush wants His prakruti. But when the bride wants the bride then, that thoughtless paramatma can never be accomplished.14

owis.original: पुरुषांचा जीव स्त्रीयांची जीवी । ऐसी नाहीं उठाठेवी । विषयसुखाची गोवी । तेथें भेद आहे ॥ २५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पुरुषांचा तो जीव आणि स्त्रीयांची ती जीवी असा कांहीं भेद करतां येत नाहीं. इंद्रियसुख भोगण्याच्या बाबतींत मात्र भेद आढळतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When the prakruti/purush is understood then, there are not the confused meddlings of feminine and masculine jivas. Then `there' has severed its fondness for the pleasure of sensual enjoyment.

owis.original: ज्या प्राण्यास जो आहार । तेथेंचि होती तत्पर । पशूचे आहारीं नर । अनादरें वर्तती ॥ २६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ज्या प्राण्याचा जो आहार असतो त्या आहाराच्या बाबातींत तो प्राणी फार तत्पर असतो. उदा. पशूचा आहार कांहीं माणसाला आवडत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: When the food of that purush is the prana then, He becomes engrossed `there' (then he is hanumanta; Lord of the breath). That man has no desire to exist on the food which animals eat (ie. he does not want to eat this gross food eaten through the senses like the beasts of the world do. He wants just to know and accepts what comes his way and in this way, the movement of the prana is always within his expanding awareness).

owis.original: आहारभेद देहेभेद । गुप्त प्रगट उदंड भेद । तैसाचि जाणावा आनंद । वेगळाला ॥ २७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्राण्यांमध्यें आहारांत भेद आहेत. शरीराचे भेद आहेत. असेच प्रगट आणि गुप्त भेद पुष्कळ आहेत. त्याचप्रमाणें प्रत्येक प्राण्याचा आनंद वेगळा असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: When that vast paramatma gets divided into the hidden atma purush and the manifest prakruti then, there come the different foods for the eight different bodies. But even this bliss/ananda (ie. the food of the atma) that should be known, should then also be left aside.

owis.original: सिंधु भूगर्भींची नीरें । त्या नीरामधील शरीरें । आवर्णोदकाचीं जळचरें । अत्यंत मोठी ॥ २८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: समुद्रामध्यें आणि पृथ्वीच्या पोटांत पाणी सांठवलेलें असतें. त्या पाण्यामध्यें व आवरणोदकामध्यें अतिशय मोठी जलचरें असतात. त्यांचा आहार व आनंद कांहीं निराळाच असतो.
owis.englishMeaning: There is this sea of water within the womb of the world (ie. soft and gross objecti- fication) and within these waters there is this `all' body (ie. end of objectification). And this `all' within that extremely huge brahman becomes apparent when one stops to objectify.

owis.original: सूक्ष्म दृष्टीं आणिता मना । शरीराचा अंत लागेना । मा तो अंतरात्मा अनुमाना । कैसा येतो ॥ २९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: माणसानें सूक्ष्म दृष्टीनें बघितलें तरी शरीराचा अंत लागत नाहीं. शरीर तर दृश्य आहे स्थूल आहे त्याचा देखील थांगपत्ता लागत नाहीं. त्याचे संपूर्ण ज्ञान होत नाहीं. मग अंतरात्मा तर अति सूक्ष्म आहे. त्याचें संपूर्ण ज्ञान होणें आणखीच कठीण आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: When the mind brings that brahman into its vision, then there is no end to this knowledge of the `all'. This is the antar-atma but this does not bring confused con- jecture.

owis.original: देह्यात्मयोग शोधून पाहिला । तेणें कांहीं अनुमानला । स्थूळसूक्ष्माचा गलबला । गथागोवी ॥ ३० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: देह आणि आत्मा यांचा संयोग झालेला आहे. त्या देहात्मासंबंधाचा जर शोध घेतला तर अंतरात्म्याची थोडीशी कल्पना येते. आत्मा अत्यंत सूक्ष्म, तर देह अत्यंत स्थूल आहे. या स्थूलसूक्ष्माच्या संयोगाच्या गडबडींत मोठाच गोंधळ माजतो.
owis.englishMeaning: If while there is this union of the body and the atma, one searches and understands then, all that conjecture becomes this `all thing'. Otherwise there is the confused en- tanglement of the union of the body and the atma.

owis.original: गथागोवी उगवाळ्याकारणें । केलीं नाना निरुपणें । अंतरात्मा कृपाळुपणें । बहुतां मुखें बोलिला ॥ ३१ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: ही गुंतागुंत उकलता यावी यासाठीं अनेक प्रकारची निरुपणें करावी लागतात. आत्म्याची कृपा झाल्यानें अशी निरुपणें पुष्कळांच्या मुखांतून बाहेर पडली आहेत.
owis.englishMeaning: In order to disentangle this confusion of the `many', this sagun discourse was made. And now that antaratma `speaks' very kindly through the mouth of this `all'. Note: maharaj Knowledge is very subtle in the beginning. It only wants to know about the Self. It is nothing but a thought only. Thought means some understanding. There he says only `I am'. Other knowledge he has not got. In that knowledge so many things have come in. When knowledge comes, space comes. Space comes then there, there is very subtle wind also. When the subtle wind is there then also subtle fire is there (etc...). So this is vidya maya, the illusion of knowledge. When it becomes objective, then it is called avidya maya... (Taken from extract of lecture in Germany. Q: What is consciousness?) .

samas.samasTitleEnglish: Nana Upasana Nirupan (A Discourse on the Various Modes of Worship)

source.name: Stotra (hymns) blog by Prakash Ketkar (ioustotra.blogspot.com) — original owi text and Marathi meaning

englishSource.name: Dasbodh, English translation by John Norwell (2015)

owis.original: पृथ्वीमधें लोक नाना । त्यास नाना उपासना । भावार्थें प्रवर्तले भजना । ठाईं ठाईं ॥ १ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जगांत अनेक प्रकारचे लोक आहेत. त्यांच्या उपसना पण अनेक प्रकारच्या आहेत. ठिकठिकाणी लोक मोठ्या श्रद्धेने भजन पूजन करीत असतात.
owis.englishMeaning: Within this earth element there are `many' worlds (maharaj every mind is a world) and then to that atma there comes the `many' forms of worship. Everywhere people are making bhajans according to their faith.

owis.original: आपुल्या देवास भजती । नाना स्तुती स्तवनें करिती । जे ते निर्गुण म्हणिती । उपासनेसी ॥ २ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: लोक आपापल्या उपास्य देवतेला भजतात. तिची स्तुतिस्तोत्रे गातात. हे सारे उपासक त्यांच्या त्यांच्या उपासनेला निर्गुण म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: They make their bhajans to their god; they praise and recite the `many' hymns and they call this the worship of the nirgun.

owis.original: याचा कैसा आहे भाव । मज सांगिजे अभिप्राव । अरे हा स्तुतीचा स्वभाव । ऐसा आहे ॥ ३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: त्यांचें हें म्हणणे खरें आहे कां? याबद्दल आपलें मत काय आहे तें मला सांगा. याचे उत्तर: अरे ! आपल्या देवतेची स्तुति करावी. हा माणसाचा स्वभाव आहे म्हणून असें घडतें.
owis.englishMeaning: The listener asked, "If that nirgun is to be worshipped then why is there even the need for this understanding of the `speech'? The importance of this `speech' therefore should be told to me." The speaker says, my dear this `speech' is the natural praise of that thoughtless Self.

owis.original: निर्गुण म्हणिजे बहुगुण । बहुगुणी अंतरात्मा जाण । सकळ त्याचे अंश हे प्रमाण । प्रचित पाहा ॥ ४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: निर्गुण म्हणजे बहुगुण किंवा पुष्कळ गुण. अंतरात्म्याच्या ठिकाणीं पुष्कळ गुण आहेत. सार्‍या उपास्य देवता निश्चितपणें अंतरात्म्याचे अंश आहेत. याचा प्रत्यक्ष अनुभव घेऊन पहावा.
owis.englishMeaning: If this mix of the gunas is to be called that nirgun then, first know that antar-atma (ie. witnessing purush) within these mixed gunas. This is the `all' and this is a part of that thoughtless Truth. Therefore understand this `experience'.

owis.original: सकळ जनासी मानावें तें । येका अंतरात्म्यास पावतें । अधिकारपरत्वें तें । मान्य कीजे ॥ ५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: प्रत्येकाच्या अंतर्यामीअंतरात्म्याचे निवासस्थान आहे. म्हणून सर्व लोकांना जें मान्य होतें तें एका अंतरात्म्यास पोचतें. अर्थात सर्वांना मान्य तें कोणतें तें पाहातांना ज्याची त्याची पात्रता पाहाणें जरुरीचे आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: If the mind shows respect to this `all' then, that reaches the One antar-atma. And afterwards that Reality should be respected by virtue of Its authority (the speaker ex- plains that first it is required to understand this knowledge. Then it will be understood that it is this hidden atma who is in fact, the beneficiary of that worship, for He is the Knower and then when this knowledge slips away, there is that Reality. Otherwise how can the mind kill itself without first understanding itself?).

owis.original: श्रोता म्हणे हा अनुमान । मुळीं घालावें जीवन । तें पावे पानोपान । हे सध्या प्रचिती ॥ ६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: श्रोता यावर असा आक्षेप घेतो कीं, आपण म्हणता ही केवळ कल्पना आहे. झाडाच्या मुळांत जर पाणी घातलें तरच तें झाडाच्या सर्व पानांना मिळतें हा रोजचा अनुभव आहे.
owis.englishMeaning: The listener says, "But I am still confused. Water should be poured directly on the roots of a plant and then, that will reach the leaves. In the same way, that thou- ghtlessness within this `all' experience should be made at this moment.' (The listener feels that pure knowledge is the goal and therefore knowledge should be skipped and that direct experience of nirgun should be understood. Then everything else will be benefitted)

owis.original: वक्ता म्हणे तुळसीवरी । उदक घालावें पात्रभरी । परी न थिरे निमिषभरी । भूमीस भेदे ॥ ७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वक्ता म्हणतो कीं, अरे हें बघ तुळशीच्या झाडावर भांडे भरुन पाणी घातलें तर तें पानांवर क्षणभर स्थिर राहात नाही. तें खालीं जमिनींत शिरतें.
owis.englishMeaning: The speaker says, even if water is poured over the leaves of a tulsi plant, still it does not stay on the leaves for even a moment and penetrates within the earth.

owis.original: थोरा वृक्षास कैसें करावें । सेंड्या पात्र कैसें न्यावें । याचा अभिप्राव देवें । मज निरोपावा ॥ ८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: यावर तू म्हणशील कीं तुळशीचें ठिक आहे पण मोठ्या वृक्षाला पाणी कसें घालावे? त्याच्या शेंड्यापर्यंत पाण्याचें भांडे कसें न्यावें? गुरुदेवांनी या अडचणींतून मार्ग दाखवावा.
owis.englishMeaning: The listener then says, "Why has that great brahman created these `many' trees in the form of human bodies and why should these outermost leaves receive the water? Therefore why should God create this `speech' even (if we are that God then, why should we make this `speech' which is merely His praise; should we not simply be Him)? This should be discoursed to me" (the listener feels that if, in truth, there is only that nirgun brahman then, why has God created the `many' people who make these `many' forms of worship; and surely we should just be brahman and then there is no need of this sagun `speech' either).

owis.original: प्रजन्याचें उदक पडतें । तें तों मुळाकडे येतें । हात चि पावेना तेथें । काये करिती ॥ ९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: याचें उत्तर असें कीं, मोठ्या झाडाच्या शेंड्यावर पावसाचें पाणी पडतें. तेथून तें मूळाकडे जातें. जेथें आपलें हात पोचत नाहींत तेथें आपण काय करणार?
owis.englishMeaning: The speaker says, the waters fall in the *rainy season and though these waters all flow towards the root (ie. `all'/knowledge) still, if they do not have the capacity to reach nirgun brahman then, what can they do? *(ie. you say "God has created", but God has not created the `many' people; this world has all been created by the clouds of ignorance and then there were the `many' desires and thoughts/rains and due to objectification, the fruits of past actions get experienced. And as long as objectification remains and one is not able to comprehend that nirgun brahman or even this `all' then, the `many' forms of worship should be maintained. These `many' worships do reach the Self indirectly and they will create a longing for deeper understanding. This `all' will be understood when one understands that it is these desires that maintain this false world of objects and stops blaming God. And when this `all' is understood then only can that brahman be directly realized. Thus everything is in your hands and no other)

owis.original: सकळास मूळ सांपडे । ऐसें पुण्य कैचें घडे । साधुजनाचें पवाडे । विवेकीं मन ॥ १० ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: मूळ सापडावें इतकें पुण्य सगळ्याकडे नसतें. जो साधु पुरुष असतो त्याचे मन मात्र विवेकानें मुळापर्यंत म्हणजे अंतरात्म्यापर्यंत पोचूं शकते बाकीच्यांचे नाही.
owis.englishMeaning: If the root is ensnared in worldly concerns then how can that merit of knowledge ever be accomplished? Therefore your mind has to become a viveki and penetrate the mind of the sadhu.

owis.original: तथापी वृक्षांचेनि पडिपाडें । जीवन घालितां कोठें पडे । ये गोष्टचें सांकडें । कांहीं च नाहीं ॥ ११ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वृक्षाच्या दृष्टांतावरुन असें ध्यानांत येईल कीं, पाणी शेंड्याला घातलें काय किंवा मुळाशीं घातलें काय., अखेर तें झाडाच्या मुळाला पोचतें. म्हणून येथें कांहींच अडचण नाहीं. उपास्यदेवतेची उपासना करणें हें झाडाच्या शेंड्याला पाणी घलण्यासारखें आहे, तर अंतरात्म्याची उपासना करणें हें मुळाला पाणी घालण्यासारखें आहे. पण अंतरात्म्याची उपासना करण्यास लागणारें सूक्ष्म मन पुण्याईनेंच लाभतें. सर्वांना तो अधिकार नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: For as long as there is the competing of these trees ("I am so and so") then, how will these waters even reach this root? (If we hold on to our concepts how can we become less objective?) Then you confine thoughtlessness within the body and even this `I am' cannot be understood. (siddharameshwar maharaj- this human body is a walking, talking, imagining tree)

owis.original: मागील आशंकचें निर्शन । होतां जालें समाधान । आतां गुणास निर्गुण । कैसें म्हणती ॥ १२ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पहिल्या शंकेचे निरसन झालें. त्यामुळें श्रोत्यांचे समाधान झालें. आतां सगुणालाच निर्गुण कां व कसें म्हणतात तें सांगांवें.
owis.englishMeaning: And though you may say that previously there had been the dissolution of all doubt and that brought thoughtless samadhan, still you should know that this was the pure sattwa guna and you cannot call this that nirgun?

owis.original: चंचळपणें विकारलें । सगुण ऐसें बोलिलें । येर तें निर्गुण उरलें । गुणातीत ॥ १३ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: जें जें कांहीं चंचळपणें, अशाश्वतपणें विकार पावतें किंवा बदलतें, त्यास सगुण असें म्हणतात. सर्व सगुण सोडून जें गुणातीत शिल्लक राहतें, त्यास निर्गुण असें म्हणतात.
owis.englishMeaning: sagun is a movement and this modification is the `speech'. But that nirgun is still and remains beyond the gunas.

owis.original: वक्ता म्हणे हा विचार । शोधून पाहावें सारासार । अंतरीं राहातां निर्धार । नांव नाहीं ॥ १४ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: वक्ता सांगतो कीं, सगुण निर्गुणाचा हा भेद बरोबर ध्यानांत येण्यास सारासार शोधून पाहावें. आपल्या अंतर्यामीं सूक्ष्म बुद्धि करुन जर आपण पाहिलें तर सगुण निश्चितपणें खरें नाहीं असें अनुभवास येईल.
owis.englishMeaning: The speaker says this vivek should be examined by discerning essence from non-essence, so that this distinction between sagun and nirgun is properly grasped. If one looks within with a subtle intellect, one will directly experience that sagun is certainly not the ultimate Truth.
owis.note: John Norwell's English translation is truncated to a single stray letter ('v') for this owi, cut off right before a page break in the source PDF with no continuation afterward. The English above is a direct rendering of the sourced Marathi meaning rather than an independently cross-checked translation.

owis.original: विविकेंचि तो मुख्य राजा । आणि सेवकाचें नांव राजा । याचा विचार समजा । वेवाद खोटा ॥ १५ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: राजे दोन प्रकारचे. एक खरा राजा सिंहासनावर बसणारा तर दुसरा " राजा " नांव असणारा नोकर तो खोटा राजा. हा भेद विवेकयुक्त विचारानें समजून घ्यावा. उगीच वाद घालीत बसूं नये. नोकराला राजा म्हणून हाक मारल्यानें तो जसा खरा राजा बनत नाहीं. त्याचप्रमाणें सगुण उपासनेला निर्गुण म्हटल्यानें ती निर्गुण होत नाहीं.
owis.englishMeaning: Due to vivek there is that great King and this `name'/`I am' is the servant of that King. When you understand the thoughtlessness (ie. King) of this `speech' (servant) then all this discussion will come to an end.

owis.original: कल्पांतप्रळईं जे उरलें । तें निर्गुण ऐसें बोलिलें । येर तें अवघेंचि जालें । मायेमधें ॥ १६ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: कल्पांतसमयीं सर्व विश्वाचा प्रलय झाला तरी जें शिल्लक उरतें त्यास निर्गुण असें म्हणतात. बाकीचे सगळें मायेच्या क्षेत्रांत झालेले असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If there is the dissolution of imagination then, mula maya remains and that nirgun Reality has become like this `speech'. Then that Reality is still in maya and afterwards It will again become the `many' things.

owis.original: सेना शाहार बाजार । नाना यात्रा लाहानथोर । शब्द उठती अपार । कैसे निवडावे ॥ १७ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: सैन्यामध्यें, शहरामध्यें, बाजारामध्यें मोठ्या यात्रेमध्यें पुष्कळ आवाज ऐकू येतात. त्यामध्यें निवडून काढणें कठिण असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: If the King's army becomes disorderly and scattered then that great brahman in the small jiva makes `many' fruitless journeys. Then how can this `I am' rise up and how can that limitless paramatma be chosen?

owis.original: काळामधें प्रज्यन्यकाळ । मध्यरात्रीं होतां निवळ । नाना जीव बोलती सकळ । कैसे निवडावे ॥ १८ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पावसाळ्यांत खूप पाऊस पडून गेला आहे. मग मध्यरात्रीं पाऊस थांबल्यावर अनेक प्राणी आवाज करतात.त्यामध्यें निवडानिवड करणें कठीण असतें.
owis.englishMeaning: When within this `time' of knowledge there is this downpour of the rains of desire and thought, then that pure knowledge gets lost in the night of ignorance. And when there are these `many' jivas then, how can even this `speech' of the `all' be chosen?

owis.original: नाना देश भाषा मतें । भूमंडळीं असंख्यातें । बहु ऋषी बहु मतें । कैसीं निवडावी ॥ १९ ॥
owis.marathiMeaning: पृथ्वीवर अनेक देश आहेत. अनेक भाषा, अनेक मतें आहेत, अनेक ऋषि आहेत, व त्यांची नाना मतें आहेत. यासगळ्यामध्यें निवडानिवड करणें कठीण असतें.
